name: Турнир ”Цветанка Христова”
description: The 'Tsvetanka Hristova' tournament is an annual athletics competition held in memory of one of Bulgaria's greatest athletes. The competition is organized for the 17th time and includes the second round of the youth athletics series 'A1 Athletics for Youth'. The tournament takes place at the Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia and gathers athletes of various ages and disciplines. It is an important event in Bulgarian athletics that honors the legacy of Tsvetanka Hristova and encourages the development of young talents.
course_highlights: Held at Vasil Levski National Stadium in Sofia
Includes the second round of the 'A1 Athletics for Youth' series
Memorial tournament in honor of Olympic medalist Tsvetanka Hristova
additional: athletics competitions, youth rounds, memorial tournament

name: Crosul de noapte
description: Night Run - Delonghi is a running race organized in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants two distances: 4 km and 10 km. The event takes place on May 8, 2026, and is suitable for runners of all levels who want to enjoy a nocturnal sports experience in the city. It is an excellent opportunity to run in an urban setting, in a friendly and competitive atmosphere.
course_highlights: Distances of 4 km and 10 km
Night running in Cluj-Napoca
Urban route accessible for all levels
additional: The event includes well-marked routes, online registration options, and a safe environment for participants.

name: Асеновградски Баири
description: Asenovgrad Bairi is a competition and festival that combines sport and entertainment in the nature of Asenovgrad and the Rhodope Mountains. The event includes mountain running and cycling, held on two separate days, allowing participants and guests to enjoy the nature and sights of the region. Organized by the Association "ASENOVGRADSKI BAIRI", the competition offers various distances for runners and cyclists, suitable for different ages and levels of fitness. Participation requires good physical condition and appropriate equipment, and the event is aimed at sports and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with control points and time limits for long distances
Running and cycling disciplines on two separate days
Opportunity to visit sights and evening entertainment between the days
additional: The competition includes children's starts on short distances, control times, and stops at certain kilometers for the long runs (47 km and 80 km). For cycling, there are different distances from 0.5 km to 60 km. The event takes place at the square "Acad. N. Haitov" in Asenovgrad. Participants should be prepared for mountain conditions and risks, including fatigue and bad weather. The disciplines include mountain running and cycling with various distances; the competition has participation regulations, including equipment and physical preparation; online registration is available, and there are different categories for participants.

name: Национален шампионат 10 000м - писта
description: The National Championship for 10,000 meters on track in Hisarya is a prestigious race organized by the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. This championship brings together the best Bulgarian athletes competing in the classic 10-kilometer track distance. The event is part of the federation's sports calendar for 2026 and highlights the traditions and development of athletics in Bulgaria.
course_highlights: Track race with a classic distance of 10,000 meters
Held in the city of Hisarya
Part of the national sports calendar of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: The first national championship in Hisarya for 10,000 meters on track is included in the sports calendar for 2026.

name: Студентско бягане "UNIRUN"
description: UNIRUN is a student running event in Sofia that combines sports with a social cause, supporting youth sports and shelters without cages. The event takes place in West Park and offers four distances with varying difficulty - from 1 km to a half marathon of 21 km. Participants join a community that inspires movement, healthy living, and social engagement, while having fun with music, games, and prizes. The run is accompanied by festival activities and opportunities for personal development and social contacts.
course_highlights: Terrain 50% asphalt and 50% park alleys with gravel
Checkpoints at different kilometers depending on the distance
Festival village with interactive tents and music
additional: Start number distribution will be held from April 21 to 23, from 9:00 to 19:00 in the South wing of the rectorate. Each distance has an official warm-up and an award ceremony. Games, raffles, and opportunities for social contacts and professional feedback are included. Official T-shirts and other merchandise with a cause to support youth sports. Distances: 1 km, 7 km, 14 km, and 21 km; support for social causes such as helping children with cerebral palsy and animals; an event with an active community and numerous prizes.

description: In Petrovaselo, in the vineyard, is a sporting event dedicated to trail running, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and to increase the number of outdoor runners. The event, organized by the Sports Club Association Alergotura in partnership with Petro Vaselo Winery, offers three running races with varied distances, held on scenic routes in the Petro Vaselo vineyard area. Participants can enjoy a sporting experience in nature, with well-marked trails and refreshment points, in a friendly and organized setting. After the race, participants are invited to relax with goulash and wine, offered based on the race number.
course_highlights: Trail running routes through the vineyard, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route involves running twice the 14 km route, with the second loop in the opposite direction
The routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at the direction change points
additional: Participants must arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. The start of the 14 km and 28 km races is at 09:00, and the 5 km race begins at 09:15. There is a time limit for finishing each race (5 km - 10:15, 14 km - 11:05, 28 km - 13:00). After the race, participants receive goulash and wine based on their race number. The routes may have muddy areas depending on weather conditions. Transfer between races is allowed before the start, subject to availability. Participants can register and check the participant list online; the event combines sport with the vineyard landscapes of Recaș.

name: The Color Run București
description: The Color Run Bucharest is a non-timed 5 km race full of color and energy, celebrating health, joy, and originality. Participants start in white clothing and are colored with colored powder every kilometer, culminating in a vibrant party at the end. The event takes place on April 25, 2026, in Bucharest, on the route along Unirii Boulevard and surrounding areas, offering a festive experience accessible to all ages. It is a celebration of movement and community, with special moments such as the cloud of colored powder and live music.
course_highlights: 5 km route along Unirii Boulevard and surrounding areas in Bucharest
Coloring points with powder every kilometer traveled
The colored powder cloud moment at the end, accompanied by music
additional: Kit pickup is available at Mega Mall Bucharest from April 18 to 24, with extended hours. The event begins with access to the event area at 12:00 PM, with successive starts between 2:00 PM and 2:20 PM, and the colored powder cloud occurs at 4:00 PM to 4:15 PM. Children aged 0-6 can participate for free without a kit, and multiple registrations are possible by adding participants in the form. The event is non-timed and open to all ages, including people with disabilities who benefit from free access. The route includes urban areas; registration includes medals and colored powder; the event features multiple waves of start and kit pickup points.

name: Maratonul Codrului
description: The Codrului Marathon, 5th edition, is an event organized by the Pro Racers Sports Club and the Romanian Cycling Federation, which will take place on April 25, 2026, at Lake Oţeloaia, Satu Mare. It is a competition dedicated to both amateurs and professionals, with MTB and Trail Run disciplines on spectacular forest trails, offering challenges for all levels. The event features new and more challenging routes for the MTB disciplines, as well as hobby categories with short routes to encourage participation. There is also a special race for children, and participants benefit from a start package, timing, hydration points, medical assistance, pasta party, and finisher medals.
course_highlights: New, more challenging MTB routes, without the road section in the last 5 km
Varied Trail Run routes, from 6 km to 43.5 km, with significant climbs
Kids Race dedicated to children, with a 2 km route and 70 m elevation gain
additional: Participation fee includes a start package with race number and sponsor products, photos from the course, hydration points on the route and at the finish, medical emergency services and Salvamont, timing, finisher medal, and pasta party. The routes may undergo modifications until the race date. Routes for MTB and Trail Run, age categories, online registration, finisher medals, technical T-shirts, event for family and community.

name: Forest Race Marghita
location: Str. Tudor Vladimirescu Nr.73, Marghita, Bihor County, Romania
description: Forest Race Marghita is a trail running competition on a rugged course with moderate difficulty, held in the deciduous forest near the town of Marghita. The event is organized by the Run For Freedom Sports Club together with the XTERRA Sport Bihor Sports Club and offers four different routes, suitable for various levels of runners. The start and finish are at the Freedom Adventure Park, and the routes are well marked on forest roads. The race promotes a healthy lifestyle and respect for the environment.
course_highlights: Marked forest trail routes
Moderate elevation changes: 460 m for the half marathon, 230 m for cross, 20 m for mini
Start and finish at the Freedom Adventure Park
additional: The official T-shirt is not included in the price and cannot be ordered through registration; the cost of the T-shirt is 100 lei, purchased separately. Participants under 18 must present a medical certificate and parental consent. Organizers may disqualify competitors who are intoxicated or without proper equipment. Registration is exclusively through the official webshop. Trail running routes in the forest, three different routes, organized by local sports clubs, first edition in spring 2022.

name: RotaRUN for Charity
price_range: taxa de înscriere (specific amount not provided)
description: RotaRUN for Charity is a sports and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the Oncology Institute "Prof. dr. Ion Chiricuță" in Cluj-Napoca. The event on April 25, 2026, includes races of 3 km, 9 km, and a 2-hour run, offering participants the opportunity to run for a noble cause and contribute to creating a modern and welcoming environment for children with cancer. Participants receive a participation kit with a t-shirt, number, and timing chip, as well as access to hydration and food points. All funds collected from registration fees are directed towards completing the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department.
course_highlights: Running route along Promenada Someșului, Cluj-Napoca
3 km race (one lap of the circuit) and RotaRun 9 km (3 laps of the circuit)
Long Run - endurance race of 2 hours
additional: The size of the t-shirt is guaranteed for registrations until April 10, 2026; after this date, sizes will be allocated in the order of registration, subject to availability. Participants receive a race number and a timing chip, access to hydration and food points with sweet and salty foods, isotonic drinks, and supplements. The top 3 male and female finishers in each event will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age groups. The event also supports the purchase of modern furniture and medical equipment for the pediatric oncology department, serving as a fundraising and community awareness project.

name: Maratonul Vinului powered by OMV Petrom
description: The Vinul Marathon powered by OMV Petrom is the first charity mountain bike race in Romania, now in its 14th edition. The event takes place in Urlați, Prahova County, on April 25, 2026, amidst the hills, vineyards, and wineries of the area. Participants can choose from several routes tailored to their level, from 4 km for children to 50 km for experienced cyclists. The race promotes cycling as a healthy lifestyle and supports important social causes.
course_highlights: 50 km route for experienced cyclists
30 km route for amateurs and juniors
18 km route recommended for less experienced cyclists
additional: The start for children (4 and 8 km) is at 09:00, for the 18, 30, and 50 km routes at 10:35, and for the Family walk at 10:45. Package pickup is available in Bucharest and on-site at specific times. Participants in the Tura Family do not receive a race kit and can go directly to the start. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 15:00, with a cut-off time of 16:30. The event also includes activities for families and children, as well as support for social and educational causes, promoting wine culture and local tourism.

name: RotaRun 2026
description: RotaRun for Charity is a sports and charity event organized by Rotary Club Cluj-Napoca, combining running with community involvement to support children with cancer. The event on April 25, 2026, aims to complete the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department at the 'Prof. Dr. Ion Chiricuță' Oncology Institute in Cluj-Napoca. Participants can choose from several races, from a 3 km cross to a 2-hour race, all held on the Someșului Promenade, with start and finish lines in the Horia Demian Sports Hall area. Funds collected from registration fees are entirely directed to the charity project.
course_highlights: Route on the Someșului Promenade in Cluj-Napoca
3 km Cross (one lap of the circuit) and RotaRun 9 km (3 laps of the circuit)
Long Run - a 2-hour race with the maximum distance covered
additional: T-shirt size is guaranteed for registrations until April 10, 2026, after which it is allocated based on availability. Participants receive a race number and timing chip, access to hydration and feeding points, as well as photos at the start/finish and along the route. The top 3 male and female finishers in each event will be awarded, both in the Open category and by age groups. The event supports the renovation of the Pediatric Oncology Department, with details about the route and registrations to be announced soon.

description: At Petrovaselo in the Vineyard is a sporting event dedicated to trail running, organized to promote a healthy lifestyle and to increase the number of outdoor runners. The event takes place in Recaș, Romania, and includes three running races on scenic vineyard routes with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km. Participants enjoy a friendly atmosphere supported by the community and local partners, with refreshment points and pleasant socializing after the race. The routes are well marked and adapted for comfort and safety, and the event is organized with the support of local authorities and sponsors.
course_highlights: Trail routes through vineyards, with distances of 5 km, 14 km, and 28 km
The 28 km route involves running twice the 14 km route, with the second loop in the opposite direction
Routes are marked with tape and signs, with volunteers at direction change points
additional: Participants must arrive at least 30 minutes before the start at Petrovaselo Winery. Participation kits are limited to a total of 1000, with specific allocations per race. After the race, participants can enjoy goulash and wine based on their race number. The routes may have muddy areas depending on weather conditions. Transfer between races is allowed before the start, subject to availability. The event includes trail activities and cultural races, open to runners of all levels. Registrations and race details are available online.

name: 140 BPM - 25 aprilie 2026
location: Parcul Regele Mihai I (Herăstrău), București, Romania
description: 140 BPM is a running race organized in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău) in Bucharest, scheduled for April 25, 2026. The event offers routes suitable for all ages, including races for children and adults, on distances of 3 km and 6 km. The routes are designed to be accessible and enjoyable, taking place on the park's pathways, providing a recreational and competitive outdoor experience. Participants can enjoy a friendly atmosphere and facilities dedicated to runners.
course_highlights: 3 km route for children (Snails / Rabbits) - a 1.5 km out-and-back lap
6 km route for adults (Turtles) - a 6 km lap
Location in King Michael I Park (Herăstrău), an attractive urban natural setting
additional: The children's race is on a short 1.5 km out-and-back route, and the adult race is a 6 km lap. The event has a tradition with previous editions in the same park, with photo galleries and results available online. The event also includes results and photo galleries from previous editions, offering an opportunity to socialize and promote an active lifestyle.

name: Pancharevo Trail Marathon
description: Pancharevo Trail Marathon is the largest spring mountain running event in Bulgaria, held near Lake Pancharevo. The race offers three distances - 42 km marathon with 1700 meters of elevation gain, 21 km half marathon with 700 meters of elevation gain to Bachun Peak, and 10 km suitable for beginners, as well as a 15 km mountain hike. The routes pass through the picturesque Lozenska Mountain with views of Vitosha, Stara Planina, Rila, and the Iskar Reservoir. The event is organized by the sports club "Begach" and attracts more participants each year.
course_highlights: 42 km marathon with 1700 m elevation gain through Lozenska Mountain
21 km half marathon with 700 m elevation gain to Bachun Peak
10 km routes with about 100 m elevation change, suitable for beginners
additional: Start packages are collected on Thursday and Friday before the race in Sofia. Support stations and medical assistance are available along the routes. The event does not provide cups; participants must bring their own bottle or cup for water. A wardrobe is available, but organizers are not responsible for lost items. Free parking is available in Pancharevo. Medical teams are present at the start, Pasarel, and Lalina Mogila. Participants must wear a bib on the chest or stomach. Multiple race categories, including mountain running and hikes; an event focused on nature and social activities; date April 26, 2026.

name: XL kmrun - Банкя
description: XL Bankya is a new race from the XLkmrun calendar, taking place in the foothills of the Lyulin Mountain near Sofia. The course is in the shape of an eight, starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya and leading to the Ostra Chuka peak. Participants can choose between two distances - 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain or 12.8 km, with the course offering challenges for mountain running enthusiasts. The race is part of the XLkmrun series, which includes various courses and distances in Sofia and other cities.
course_highlights: The course is in the shape of an eight starting from the northern outskirts of Bankya
Per lap length of 6.4 km with 217 meters of positive elevation gain
Option to choose between one or two laps (6.4 km or 12.8 km)
additional: The course is the idea of Miroslav Spasov. The race is organized at the location of the spring relay. Part of the 5kmrun calendar with other events in Sofia and the country. Race in the foothills of Lyulin Mountain, date 2026-04-26

name: Бистрица Вертикал Рън
description: Bistritsa Vertical Run is a picturesque and challenging race that starts from the village of Bistritsa, accessible by public transport. The course passes through diverse terrain with smooth but demanding ascents, reaching the Kikiš area with panoramic views of Sofia. The route continues to the Kamен del hut, where participants can refresh themselves with food and drinks. This race is an excellent training for strength and endurance, suitable for preparing for long distances and mountain running.
course_highlights: Start from the village of Bistritsa with easy access by bus №98
Smooth but demanding ascent with 500 m positive elevation to the Kikiš area
Panoramic views of Sofia and the opportunity for rest and support at the Kamен del hut
additional: The route includes a variety of surfaces - from forest trails to rocky sections, which helps adaptation to different conditions. In the Kikiš shelter area, shelter and food are available on weekends. Running in nature provides recovery away from city noise. terrain, marathon preparation, natural environment

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване за мъже и жени и юноши и девойки под 20 г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill for men, women, juniors, and under 20s will be held on April 26, 2026, in Sofia, Bistritsa village. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and offers a challenging mountain run with an uphill course, suitable for various age groups. Organizers provide official registration and support for the competitors, with communication conducted directly with them. The event is traditional and attracts athletes seeking a competitive experience in mountain terrain.
course_highlights: Mountain running with uphill course in the Bistritsa village area, Sofia
Race for men, women, juniors, and under 20s
Held under the auspices of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation
additional: Contact with the organizer is recommended for all inquiries. The race is part of the national mountain running championship and takes place in Bistritsa village, Sofia. It is part of the national mountain running series with a focus on uphill running, providing opportunities for participation across different age groups.

description: The Iași Half Marathon is the largest running event in Northeast Romania, held annually in Palace of Culture Square. The half marathon course consists of two loops passing through the start area, offering runners a unique experience on the main streets of the city, with vehicle traffic stopped and revitalization points. The event has a strong charitable component, supporting children from disadvantaged backgrounds through educational and social projects. Participation in the half marathon, cross 10 km, and popular races is an opportunity to do good and be part of a community dedicated to positive change.
course_highlights: Course on main streets with vehicle traffic stopped
Passing in front of the Palace of Culture
Revitalization points for hydration and medical assistance
additional: Participants in the half marathon, 10 km cross, and 5 km cross races receive a disposable chip and a technical participation T-shirt. Registrations can be made online until the deadline, and after that, depending on availability, offline registrations can be made at the Iași Half Marathon island in Palas Mall. Same-day registrations are not allowed. The event provides an ambulance for medical assistance and many photos at the finish line and along the course. Participation includes hydration points, medical assistance, a participation kit, and the option to participate online or offline. The event has a charitable purpose, supporting projects for disadvantaged children.

description: Bucharest International Half Marathon by Constantina Diță is an international half marathon race held on the most beautiful and fastest streets of Bucharest, offering the opportunity for a competitive personal record for both professional athletes and amateur runners. The event also includes 10 km races, races for people with mobility impairments, and a popular 3.5 km race for all ages. The participation kit includes a race number with chip timing and a medal for finishers, while the official T-shirt is optional. The organizer is the Constantina Diță Sports Club Association, and the event is supported by major partners such as Decathlon.
course_highlights: Flat and fast course on Bucharest's main streets
Certified by World Athletics Label for half marathon
Dedicated routes for half marathon, 10 km, people with disabilities, and popular race
additional: Participation kits are exclusively pick-up in person at the Expo with proof of identity. The official T-shirt is optional and can be purchased separately for 15 EUR. Participation of wheelchair users is free of charge. The maximum time for the half marathon is 3 hours, and for the 10 km race is 1.5 hours. Some streets will be closed during the event, and it is recommended to use public transportation, especially the metro to Aviatorilor station. The route includes options for running and walking, with the possibility of setting records; the event also includes other races such as 10 km and relays.

name: URME PE PLAY
price_range: prima înscriere este gratuită, alte detalii nu sunt specificate
description: Urme pe Play is a mountain running competition held in the commune of Rășinari, at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru mountains. The routes are marked and include natural trails, forest roads, and asphalt, offering an authentic sub-mountain experience. The event is open to both adults and children, with dedicated races for each age category. Participants can enjoy scenic spring landscapes and the friendly atmosphere of the local community in an event that combines sport with local culture and traditions.
course_highlights: Marked trail routes in Rășinari and the hills at the foot of the Cindrel and Lotru mountains
Varied surfaces: asphalt, forest roads, natural trails, and meadows
Picturesque spring landscapes at the foot of the mountains
additional: Participation is at one's own risk, with the signing of a liability declaration. The minimum age is 14 years for the Fuguț race and 18 years for the Cross, Semi, Marathon, and Ultra Marathon. Children under 14 can participate in dedicated races. The registration package is not shipped by mail. The organizer may prohibit the start or continuation of the race in case of inadequate physical condition. The event also includes cultural activities, hikes, and a market with local products, providing an opportunity to discover the traditions and beauty of the Rășinari area.

name: 10 дневно състезание „Шри Чинмой“
location: Парк „Св. Св. Петър и Павел“, София, България
description: The 10-day Sri Chinmoy Race in Sofia is the first certified multi-day race in Bulgaria, held at St. Peter and Paul Park. The race takes place on a 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop, with each participant competing to cover the maximum distance within 10 days. The event is organized with attention to detail, including official lap counting and strict rules for fairness and safety. Participants can enjoy the atmosphere of the race village and the support of organizers and fellow runners.
course_highlights: 785-meter flat, certified asphalt loop
Held at St. Peter and Paul Park in Sofia
Minimum daily distance of 43.44 km (27 miles)
additional: Every day of the race starts at 8:00 AM. Each participant wears a visible race number at the front. Laps are counted by a judge who changes every six hours. There is also a backup camera system for counting. If a participant interrupts the race or leaves the track, they must inform the judge. It is possible to count a "hotel lap" when leaving and returning to the track at certain points. Consumption of alcohol, smoking, and drug use are prohibited within the camp and on the track. There is a minimum dress code for running and in the park, prohibiting running without upper clothing. Official results are published the next day around 9:00 AM on www.srichinmoyraces.bg. Terrain: asphalt track, 785 m; registration until April 1, 2026; personal helper fee 35 euros/day; vegetarian meals and medical assistance included.

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is a sports event in Stara Zagora, which includes mountain running and mountain biking. Organized by the Non-Profit Association Cycling and Tourism Club "Zarata" with the support of the Municipality of Stara Zagora and the Tourist Association "Sarnena Gora", the competition offers various distances for running and cycling in Ayazmo Park. Participants must have valid insurance and sign a liability waiver. The event begins with registration and briefing from 07:00 to 08:00, and the awards ceremony is at 17:00.
course_highlights: Mountain running and mountain biking in Ayazmo Park
Running distances: 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km, and 38 km (ultra)
Cycling with eBike MTB up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra trail
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers from 07:00 to 08:00. Mandatory helmet use for cyclists. Payment is only via bank transfer or at EasyPay cash desks after online registration. Participants must have valid accident insurance for the day of the event (except UCI cardholders). Awards at 17:00 for both disciplines. Cycling routes will include approximately 32 km hobby trail and 42 km ultra trail; online registration, bank transfer payment; requirement for valid insurance and wearing a helmet for cyclists.

description: Running in Făgăraș is a sporting event that brings together runners of all ages and performance levels to explore the natural and cultural beauty of the Făgăraș area. The routes offer a complete experience, with steep climbs, descents through spectacular landscapes, and well-organized hydration points, while the start and finish take place near the historic fortress. The atmosphere is friendly and motivating, supported by an enthusiastic community and dedicated volunteers. The event promotes mass sport and respect for nature, providing a memorable day of running and socializing amidst mountain scenery.
course_highlights: Steep climbs and descents through spectacular landscapes
Start and finish near Făgăraș fortress
Rich hydration points and very good marking
additional: Premium finisher medal, cash prizes for podium finishers, ITRA points and UTMB index for the Maratonu’ de pe Ardeal and Belvedere races, hot meal voucher after the race, medical assistance with ambulance, massage tent, feeding and hydration points on the route and at the finish, option for a technical running shirt for an additional cost. Multiple race categories including marathon, trail, cross, and relays; the event also includes cultural and tourist activities, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the natural beauty of the Făgăraș area.

name: MaricaRUN
description: MaricaRUN 2026 is a unique sporting event featuring distances of 5 and 10 kilometers, as well as a 1 km children's run, held in the beautiful Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. The race combines sport, emotions, and a charitable cause, with 40% of the entry fees donated to charity. The route is flat, suitable for all levels, and passes through the most beautiful parts of the park with views of the Maritsa River. Participants will enjoy a well-organized route with refreshment stations and a festive atmosphere with prizes and sports demonstrations.
course_highlights: Flat route suitable for all levels
Passes along the Maritsa River and relaxation zones with water views
10 km route consists of 2 laps around the park
additional: Start packages can be collected in advance on May 1st from 18:00 to 20:00 or on race day. Races are on May 2nd: 10 km at 10:00, 5 km at 10:15, and a 1 km children's run at 10:20. An award ceremony will take place at 11:40. 40% of the entry fees are donated to charity. Participants receive medals, and winners receive cups, vouchers, and gifts. There will be sports demonstrations, physical challenges, and a raffle with prizes. The course runs through Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad. Registration is online or on-site, and participants receive medals and the chance to win prizes. Places are limited.

name: Коджа Кая
location: село Билка, район връх Коджа Кая, България
description: Kozha Kaya is Bulgaria's first fully autonomous ultramarathon, held in the village of Bilka, in the Kozha Kaya peak area. The race offers various distances with significant positive elevation gains and no support stations, making it a true test of endurance and skills. Participants are challenged to finish before sunset, enjoying stunning views and natural beauty. This is an event for adventure and mountain running enthusiasts, leaving a lifelong memory.
course_highlights: 75 km with 4400 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
42 km marathon with over 2700 m positive elevation gain without support stations
30 km Sky with 1950 m positive elevation gain and full autonomy
additional: All distances are with full autonomy, without support stations. There is an additional challenge - a speed ascent of Kozha Kaya 3.6 km with 500 m positive elevation gain. The event takes place in a natural environment rich in flora and fauna, offering breathtaking views and challenging terrains. The race is scheduled for May 1-2, 2026, with participants able to choose between different distances suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs. Registration is available on the official website.

name: МарицаРън 2026
location: Димитровград, Парк Марица, Димитровград, Хасково, България
description: MaritsaRun 2026 is a professionally organized race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The event offers three distances - 1 km for children up to 14 years old, 5 km for a fun sports challenge, and 10 km for a greater personal achievement. The course passes through the most beautiful parts of Maritsa Park in Dimitrovgrad, including alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations. Participants will enjoy a good atmosphere with music, an audience, and support along the route, as well as prizes and recognition with a prize fund of over 1500 euros.
course_highlights: The course passes through the main entrance, alleys, the river, relaxation zone, and art installations of Maritsa Park
Distances: 1 km children's run, 5 km and 10 km for adults
Hydration stations and support along the route
additional: Registration is possible online or on-site on the day of the event if there are available starting numbers. Late registration is possible after 15.04.2026. Medals for all finishers and monetary and material prizes for the winners. The event features music, professional photographers, and a festive atmosphere. Registration is online or on-site, with late registration after 15.04. The event includes a children's run and routes in Maritsa Park, supporting a healthy lifestyle and community.

name: Sălciua Trail Run
location: Sălciua de Jos, Alba County, Romania
description: Salciua Trail Run 2026 is a trail running competition held in the commune of Salciua, located between the Trascau Mountains and Mount Mare, offering a spectacular view. The event brings together enthusiasts of running, nature, culture, and fun, providing an opportunity to escape the daily routine and enjoy the beauty of nature with loved ones. The competition includes four races: Zmeilor Race (28 km), Liliecilor Cross (15 km), Family and Young Run (5 km), and Spiridusilor Race (400-800 m), open to all participants who meet age and registration conditions. Organizers ensure a complete experience, with race kits, award ceremony, and thematic workshops for all ages.
course_highlights: Trails through natural reserves, hills, and meadows
Areas with waterfalls and caves unique to the region
Natural setting between the Trascau Mountains and Mount Mare, altitude 700-1400 m
additional: Kit pickup on race day between 07:00-08:30. Starts in order: Liliecilor Cross (15 km) at 09:00, Family and Young Run (5 km) at 09:30, Spiridusilor Race (400-800 m) at 10:00. Award ceremony begins at 13:00. The event includes thematic workshops for children and adults during breaks. Participation includes various race categories, with details about registration conditions and schedule, all planned for May 2026.

name: Chindia City Race
location: Piața Tricolorului, Târgoviște, Dâmbovița County, Romania
description: Chindia City Race is a traditional race organized in the heart of Târgoviște Citadel, right next to the iconic Chindia Tower. The event takes place on May 2, 2026, in Tricolor Square, and gathers participants of all ages, in an atmosphere of celebration and friendly competition. The start is scheduled for 10:00 AM, and the race celebrates the spirit and history of the city, inviting runners to test their speed and endurance on an energetic and traditional urban route.
course_highlights: Start in Tricolor Square, in the historic center of Târgoviște
Urban route with views of the Citadel and Chindia Tower
Event dedicated to all age groups and fitness levels
additional: The start area is in Tricolor Square, Târgoviște. The event has a festive atmosphere and is open to everyone, with a recommendation to wear appropriate footwear and bring good stamina. The event is part of Carpat Race and is supported by the local community, offering an opportunity to promote health and physical activity in Târgoviște.

name: Még egy kört / Încă o rundă - Trail challenge
location: Világlátó, Sfântu Gheorghe, Covasna County, Romania
description: Another evening trail running challenge held on the outskirts of Sfântu Gheorghe, on a wooded and hilly terrain known as "Világlátó." Participants can choose to run or practice Nordic Walking for 2, 4, or 6 hours, trying to complete as many laps as possible of 1.6 km with a elevation gain of +60 m. The event is designed as a mental and physical challenge, offering a pleasant atmosphere with music and a bar on site. It is an excellent opportunity for running enthusiasts and others to test themselves in a natural and friendly environment.
course_highlights: Wooded and hilly terrain known as "Világlátó"
Lap of 1.6 km with +60 m elevation gain
Challenge of 2, 4, or 6 hours with Nordic Walking option
additional: Sticks for Nordic Walking are available in limited numbers upon request via email. On site, there will be music and Wunderbar. Each participant receives a start pack with a race number and other promotional materials. The event is a combination of running and mental challenge, with the possibility to complete as many laps as possible within the chosen interval. Trail challenge with 1.6 km loops, options for running or Nordic walking, part of the Szent György Napok event.

name: Mechi Chal Trail Chepelare
price_range: 15 € до 30 € за участие, 20 € за тениска на събитието
description: Mechi Chal Trail is an exciting mountain race taking place on May 3, 2026, in Chepelare, at the Olympic Square. The courses pass through mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains, suitable for both beginners and experienced trail runners. The race offers three distances with varying elevation gains, challenging participants with true mountain terrain. Every finisher receives a medal, and the winners are awarded cash and material prizes.
course_highlights: Mountain routes and forest trails in the Rhodope Mountains
Distances with positive elevation gain from 420 m to 1640 m
Start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare
additional: Start packages are distributed on May 2 from 15:00 to 20:00 at Borika Hotel and on May 3 from 8:00 at the Olympic Square. Participants under 16 years old can only participate in the 7.6 km distance. Every finisher receives a medal, and prizes for the top three places include cash and material awards. It is recommended to fill out participation declarations in advance. Payment at the moment is only via bank transfer. The distances include 7.6 km, 15 km, and 30 km with positive elevation gains of 420 m, 820 m, and 1640 m respectively; start and finish at the Olympic Square in Chepelare; the courses are in mountain and forest terrains.

name: НШ по планинско бягане - изкачване и спускане мъже и жени, под 20 г., под 18г., под 16г.
description: The National Mountain Running Championship - uphill and downhill for men and women, as well as for boys and girls under 20, under 18, and under 16, is held in Chepelare. The competition offers a challenging mountain terrain that tests the endurance and skills of the participants. This is an important sports event in the Bulgarian athletics calendar, attracting both young and experienced runners. The organizers provide professional organization and support for all participants.
course_highlights: Mountain terrain with uphill and downhill sections
Categories for men, women, and boys and girls under 20, 18, and 16
Held in the picturesque area of Chepelare
additional: For all inquiries, participants should contact the organizer directly at the provided email. The event is part of the Bulgarian Athletics Federation calendar and is officially supported. It is included in the national mountain running calendar and offers participation opportunities across various age groups.

name: РЕКОРД НА ХАЙДУШКАТА ПЪТЕКА 2026
description: Heidiushka Path Record 2026 is an annual race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven. Participants compete in climbing the iconic trail from the start to the large fountain near the Karanli Hotel, with various route options of different difficulty levels. The race is for prestige, with no categories or prize fund, and results are officially recorded and published for each participant who completes the trail in under 1 hour. This is a unique challenge for mountain running and nature enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Climbing the iconic Heidiushka Path in Sinite Kamani Nature Park
Route with various variations - the shortest is the steepest and most difficult
Finish at the large fountain near Karanli Hotel
additional: The race has no categories, age restrictions, or prize fund. Only the time from start to finish is measured. The record holder's name is inscribed on a special plaque at the beginning of the trail. Participants with times under 1 hour have their results published on the Foundation "Stari Bryast" website. The event includes trail running with different routes and no categories or prizes, emphasizing personal achievements and records.

name: ЮНАШКИ ИГРИ 2026
description: Yunashki Games 2026 are held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park near Sliven on May 6th, in honor of Haji Dimitar's birthday and Gergyovden - the Day of Bravery. The event is dedicated to the traditions and spirit of the hajduks, including games and competitions that they used to measure their strength when choosing a voivode. The course and atmosphere are connected to the region's historical heritage and the natural beauty of Sinite Kamani. It is organized by the Old Oak Foundation, which works to preserve the cultural heritage and nature of Sliven.
course_highlights: Held in Sinite Kamani Nature Park with alpine-type terrain
The course passes along ancient hajduk trails and near 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
A place with numerous rocky peaks, steep slopes, caves, and waterfalls
additional: The event is part of the traditional patriotic causes of the Old Oak Foundation, held in honor of historical figures and events related to the hajduks and Bulgarian history. Registration and briefing take place at the Information Center of Sinite Kamani Nature Park; competitions include stone throwing and knife throwing; participants in folk costumes are encouraged.

name: Международен турнир за юноши и девойки под 18 г. „Младост”
description: The Youth and Junior Athletics Tournament "Mladost" is held at the City Stadium in Ruse. This is a competition with a rich tradition, bringing together young athletes from different countries to compete in various athletics disciplines. The tournament aims to promote youth sports and provides an opportunity for talented competitors under 18 years old to showcase their skills. Organizers emphasize the importance of registered achievements for participation in some disciplines, such as the long jump for girls under 18.
course_highlights: Competitions at the City Stadium in Ruse
International participation of boys and girls under 18
21 athletics disciplines
additional: Participation in the long jump for girls under 18 requires registered achievements; athletes without such achievements will not be admitted. The competition includes 21 disciplines with over 300 participants. Results and start lists are publicly available. Participation is open to young athletes under 18, and the event is part of preparations for European championships and international competitions.

name: Трън Ултра Рън
description: Trun Ultra Run is an ultramarathon mountain running race held in the picturesque region of Kraiishte, centered in the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality. The race offers four routes of varying lengths and elevation gains, passing through the Ruy, Ezimir and Reben mountains, with numerous panoramic views and diverse terrain from soft trails to rocky sections. Organized by the Trun Tourist Society with the support of Trun Municipality, the event is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts seeking a challenge and beautiful nature.
course_highlights: The routes pass through the peaks Maly Ruy, Orlovets, Rakitki Kamik, and the Erma River Gorge
Diverse terrain - soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and panoramic views
additional: All routes are circular with start and finish in Turokovtsi village. Support stations with water and food are available along the routes, but cups are not provided. Each participant must have mandatory insurance. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. The routes are circular, with support points and medical assistance; participants must carry mandatory equipment and use GPS tracks. The race is part of a series of routes and is certified by ITRA.

name: Alpinist TRI
description: Climbing Triathlon "New Life for Alpiniist Hut" is a unique race that replaces traditional swimming with a vertical challenge. It takes place in the area of Alpiniist Hut and Basarbovo village, Ruse, and includes three disciplines: MTB cycling, running, and final ascent via Via Ferrata. The race is both individual and relay, with all proceeds going towards the restoration of the hut. It is an opportunity to test your strength against nature and support a noble cause in one of the most beautiful regions of Polomieto.
course_highlights: MTB cycling 21 km with +350 m elevation gain
Running 10 km with +220 m elevation gain
Final ascent via the newest Via Ferrata in Northern Bulgaria
additional: The start is in front of Alpiniist Hut, Basarbovo. The relay team consists of two people, with the fee being for the entire team. Relay categories are male, female, and mixed. The event supports the restoration of Alpiniist Hut. Routes: MTB 21 km, running 10 km, Via Ferrata; categories: individual and relay; location: Alpiniist Hut, Basarbovo; date: May 9, 2026.

name: Amusnet Charity Run 2026
description: Amusnet Charity Run 2026 is a trail run with a cause, taking place near the village of Zheleznitsa, close to Sofia. The course is just over 5 km and features diverse terrain with a beautiful forest trail, a challenging ascent, and a final descent. The event is open to everyone - for running and walking, with the main goal of participating and supporting the National Paralympic Federation. For every kilometer covered, Amusnet donates 5 euros to support the cause, which helps Bulgarian athletes with disabilities.
course_highlights: 0-3 km: flat and beautiful forest trail
3-4 km: serious ascent of about 1 km
4-5+ km: descent and final sprint to the finish
additional: Professional timing with published results after the event. Parking near the start is limited; it is recommended to use the large parking lot at the end of the village, about 2 km walk to the start-finish area. Participation is free. The course is just over 5 km with diverse terrain; support for Paralympians; registration via the form; limited parking capacity; prizes for participants and staff.

name: Tran Ultra Run
description: Trun Ultra Run is a mountain race held in the picturesque region of Kraiishte, centered in the village of Turokovtsi, Trun Municipality. The race offers four routes of varying lengths and ascents, passing through the mountains Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben, with numerous peaks and panoramic views. The courses are circular, with diverse terrain including soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and forest areas. Organized by the Trun Tourist Society with the support of Trun Municipality, the event provides marking, refreshment points, and medical assistance for participants.
course_highlights: Four circular routes of 14 km, 23 km, 43 km, and 64 km with ascents from 700 to 3300 meters
Routes through the mountains Ruy, Ezimirska, and Greben with numerous peaks and panoramic views
Diverse terrain including soft trails, rocky sections, steep inclines, and forest areas
additional: All routes are circular with start and finish in the village of Turokovtsi. There are refreshment points along the courses with water and food, but cups are not provided. Participants are required to have mandatory insurance. Medical personnel and an ambulance are available at the start/finish. Use of GPS tracks in .gpx format is recommended. Multiple routes of different lengths through scenic Bulgaria, awaiting certification from ITRA.

It is an excellent opportunity to discover the beauty of the area and to experience the joy of running in nature.

Timing with an integrated electronic chip in the race number

location: Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud, Bistrița-Năsăud, Romania
description: Trail Run in Țara Năsăudului is a nature running event designed for all age groups and experience levels, held around Casuțele din Plai, Valea Caselor, Năsăud. The event offers three different races: a 2 km route for children and families, an intermediate 5 km route with short climbs and forest trails, and a 10 km route dedicated to runners seeking an authentic trail running challenge. Participants enjoy a supportive atmosphere, socializing, and fair play, with hydration points along the routes and a Starter Kit included for the 5 km and 10 km races.

5 km route with short climbs, forest trails, and views of the surrounding hills near Năsăud
10 km route with 2 hydration points, dedicated to runners who love authentic trail running challenges

Car access to the start is prohibited; organizers provide minibuses from the parking lot at the Năsăud city chapel (meeting point and parking). The routes are available on Strava, with the option to download GPX files for smartwatch or phone. The Starter Kit includes the official T-shirt and medal for the 10K, medal for the 5K, and diploma for the 2K. The 1st place in the 10K Challenge also receives 2 nights of accommodation at Casuțele din Plai. The event features routes suitable for all ages and levels, emphasizing nature, community, and fair play, with the start in Valea Caselor, Năsăud.

description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, held in scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. The routes pass through spectacular locations such as Piatra Secuiului, Cetatea Colțești, Cheile Plaiului, and Huda lui Papară Cave, providing a mountain running experience with significant elevation changes and impressive views. The event is organized by the Green & Wild Association and emphasizes adventure in nature and local heritage. Participants benefit from hydration and nutrition points, medals, and prizes, and registrations are limited and done online.

The half marathon climbs Piatra Secuiului and crosses the Creasta de Cocoș with views over the Trascău Cliffs
The cross-country offers an accessible mountain experience with peaceful landscapes in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif

Technical briefings are held before the start for each event. Medals are awarded only to those who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the post-award raffle, with attendance mandatory for the draw. Trail race with multiple categories, picturesque mountain terrain, cultural and natural landmarks, registrations open until September 2026, free participation for persons with disabilities.

location: село Еленово, местност "Кара дере", община Нова Загора, област Сливен, Bulgaria

description: Elenovo Trail Run is a new mountain running event in Nova Zagora Municipality, Sliven Province. The race takes place in the picturesque area "Kara Dere" near the village of Elenovo, with various routes suitable for runners of different levels. The event is part of the regional folklore festival and offers a unique opportunity for sport and nature combined with local traditions. Organizers provide GPX files for the routes to assist participants in their preparation.
course_highlights: Routes with lengths of 4 km, 10/11 km, and 20/21 km in mountain terrain
Area "Kara Dere" with scenic views and natural beauty
Held within a folklore festival with a rich cultural program
additional: GPX files for the routes are available for download and preparation. The event takes place in an area with the "Kara Dere" dam. The organizer is the Tourist Information Center - Nova Zagora, with coordinator Daniel Yordanov. The routes are available as downloadable GPX files; the event includes various routes and cultural events in the "Kara Dere" area.

name: Sunrise Ultra
description: Sunrise Ultra is a challenging run along the rugged rocks of Bulgaria's northern coast, offering three distances - 42 km, 17 km, and 7 km. The race passes through iconic natural and cultural landmarks in the municipalities of Kavarna and Shabla, combining endurance and the beauty of the seaside landscape. Participants receive a special T-shirt and medal inspired by the sunrise and the sea, symbolizing the spirit of the event. This is a unique experience for nature and running enthusiasts seeking adventure and inspiration.
course_highlights: 42 km rugged coastal beauty with endless horizon
17 km through breathtaking cliffs and sea breeze
7 km fast and impressive kilometers along the coast
additional: Start packages are available in the cities of Varna and Shabla with a signed participation declaration. When collecting a start package for another participant, a signed declaration from them is required. Participants under 18 years old need a parental consent declaration. The medal symbolizes the sunrise, waves, and the path, while the T-shirt is an artistic interpretation of the event. After the race, participants can celebrate with wine from the partner Villa Daros. The event includes races of various distances, supported by local authorities, and offers a unique opportunity to run amidst the natural beauty of the Black Sea coast.

name: Wings for Life
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair participants, taking place on May 10, 2026, in Borisova Gradina, Sofia. Instead of a traditional finish line, participants run until they are caught by the virtual "Catcher Car," which starts 30 minutes after the beginning and gradually increases its speed. The event raises funds for spinal cord research, with 100% of registration fees and donations going to this cause. Participants can gather at the popular spot "Sun" in Borisova Gradina and join via the Wings for Life World Run mobile app.
course_highlights: Start at the popular "Sun" area in Borisova Gradina
1.8 km of asphalt paths in the park
1.2 km of dirt and gravel trail, followed by 1.8 km of wide asphalt road
additional: The race is accessible for wheelchair participants. The virtual "Catcher Car" begins chasing participants 30 minutes after the start at a speed of 14 km/h, which gradually increases. 100% of registration fees and donations are directed to spinal cord research. Participants must use the Wings for Life World Run mobile app to participate and track their progress. Participants can join via the app or on-site, as the event is focused on charity and supporting scientific research. The event is open to all ages and fitness levels.

name: XL kmrun - Плана
description: The XL Race is a trail race, part of the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the area of the village of Plana, near Sofia, in the Plana mountain. Participants can choose between three distances - 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km, which pass through open terrains with diverse conditions, including wet and sunny sections. The race is suitable for mountain running enthusiasts looking for a challenge in a natural environment.
course_highlights: Three distances: 5.5 km, 11 km, and 16.5 km
The route is open, without shade, with diverse terrains
Held in the Plana mountain near Sofia
additional: Choice of three distances with different lengths. The route is mostly open, which can be challenging in strong sunlight. Organized by 5kmrun. The race is held annually in May in the area of the village of Plana. Trail races, distances 5.5 km, 11 km, 16.5 km, taking place in the area of the village of Plana.

name: Луковит рън
description: The Lukovit Run road race is an annual competition with a length of 8.8 kilometers, starting from the center of Lukovit and reaching the Prohodna Cave. The event attracts runners of various ages and levels, with notable winners such as Ismail Senandzhi and Marinela Nineva. It is part of the sports calendar of Lukovit Municipality and offers a mass start of 800 meters for younger participants. The course is scenic and challenging, combining urban and natural environments.
course_highlights: The course is 8.8 km long from the center of Lukovit to Prohodna Cave
Includes a mass start of 800 meters for younger participants
Held in a scenic natural and urban environment
additional: The oldest participant was 70 years old. The winner, Ismail Senandzhi, has five victories on the course. The event also features a mass start of 800 meters. It takes place on May 10, 2026, with cash prizes for the winners and medals for participants. The event is part of the Run Bulgaria series and is popular among running enthusiasts in the region.

description: The Rose Valley Marathon in Kazanlak is a sporting event designed for all running enthusiasts, with the main goal of increasing physical activity and showcasing the beauty of the Rose Valley in Bulgaria. The competition includes three distances - a classic marathon of 42 km, a half marathon of 21 km, and a 10 km race. The start and finish are at Rozarium Park in front of the Rose Museum in Kazanlak, and the course passes through the city area, bike lanes, and secondary road network, with an elevation of about 100 meters. The event takes place on May 10, 2026, starting at 09:00 AM, and offers refreshment points every 5 km, as well as awards in various categories.
course_highlights: The first 10 km are in the city area
The course passes through bike lanes and secondary road network
Elevation around 100 meters

name: Wings for Life World App Run : Oradea
description: Wings for Life World Run is a unique global race for runners and wheelchair users, where there is no fixed finish line. Participants run to stay ahead of the Virtual Catcher Car, which starts 30 minutes after the start and gradually increases its speed until everyone is caught. The event in Oradea, Romania, on May 10, 2026, takes place on a 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory. All registration fees and donations go entirely to spinal cord injury research.
course_highlights: 1.7 km paved circuit inside the Nokian Tyres factory
Open participation for runners and wheelchair users
Virtual Catcher Car starts 30 minutes after the start and increases speed gradually
additional: The event is accessible for wheelchair participants. The start is simultaneous worldwide, and the Virtual Catcher Car begins chasing 30 minutes after the start with an initial speed of 14 km/h, increasing progressively. 100% of registration fees and donations are directed towards spinal cord injury research projects. The event supports participation at any distance, with no fixed finish line, and includes registration via an app. Participants can run individually or in groups, and all funds raised are allocated to spinal cord injury research.

name: VW Mureș Half Marathon
description: VW Mureș Half Marathon 2026 invites you to run in the heart of Transylvania, through the city center of Târgu Mureș, on May 10, 2026. The event offers various routes of 21 km, 10 km, 5 km, a 4x5 km relay, and a children's race, all starting and finishing in the central area, ideal for support from family and friends. Participants will discover the city's representative tourist spots in a vibrant spring atmosphere, enjoying prizes, medals, and good energy with every step. The organizer is the Mureș Runners Association, which promotes a healthy lifestyle and community through sport.
course_highlights: Routes through the center of Târgu Mureș, with representative tourist points

The mandatory equipment at the start includes running shoes, sportswear, and a visible race number. The event promotes environmental protection, with a ban on littering outside designated areas. Participants can choose from multiple distances, including half marathon, relay, and children's race; the event encourages physical activity and local tourism in Târgu Mureș.

name: Budureasa Mountain Running
description: Budureasa Mountain Running is a mountain running race organized by ACS Bihorul Oradea in partnership with the Budureasa Town Hall and the Local Council. The event includes two main categories: Eco Cross 8 km and Cross 16 km, dedicated to endurance runners aged at least 14 years. The routes start and end in front of the Budureasa Cultural Center, offering a mountain experience with ascents and descents on stone roads, trail, and asphalt. Along the course, there are revitalization points with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Participation is open to all capable runners, with special conditions for minors under 18.
course_highlights: Shared route for Eco Cross 8 km and Cross 16 km up to km 4.5 with a revitalization point
Steep ascents and significant elevation changes, including a 450 m climb with a 170 m positive difference
Last kilometers on asphalt, with hydration points and gentle descents
additional: Participation confirmation is done on Saturday between 16:00 - 20:00 or on race day between 8:00 - 10:30 at the Budureasa Cultural Center. Technical meeting on Saturday 09.05.2026 between 19:00 - 19:30 and on race day at 10:00. There are 3 revitalization points along the route for the 16 km Cross and 1 point for the 8 km Eco Cross with water, isotonic drinks, and fruits. Registrations are only valid after payment of the fee, and changes or cancellations can only be made in writing until 26.04.2026. Athletes suspended for doping are not allowed to participate. The route may be modified due to weather conditions; online registration is open until May 3, 2026, with on-site registration also possible; restrictions apply for minors; anti-doping rules are enforced.

Participants receive a kit with a t-shirt, bandana, temporary tattoos, medal, and colored powder, and the event promotes a healthy lifestyle and community.

The medal and colored powder are given at the finish. Participants receive a participation kit with a t-shirt, race number, bandana, tattoo, medal, and colored powder; the event promotes a healthy and active lifestyle; pets and vehicles are not allowed on the course.

The routes include central areas of the city, and the funds collected support the project "Casa InimiiLor", a therapeutic refuge for children. Participation is a demonstration of solidarity and hope for those in need.

Charitable support for the children of the "Inima Îți Vorbește" Association through the Casa InimiiLor project

description: IHB Business Run Varna is the largest team-building race in Bulgaria, held at the BulYard shipyard and Bulport Logistics in Varna. It is a relay race for teams of 4 people, with each participant running 4 km before passing the baton to the next. The event combines sports spirit and corporate teamwork, attracting many companies and their employees in a dynamic and friendly format. In addition to the main race, there is a Kids Run for children aged 4 to 12 with the support of certified coaches.

name: EcoRun Moieciu ~ 2026
description: EcoRun Moieciu is a top mountain running event in Romania, held in Moieciu de Sus. The race includes Marathon, Semi, and Cross categories, as well as a race for children, EcoKids. The routes are composed of approximately 90% forest roads and mountain trails, offering an authentic outdoor running experience with spectacular scenery and a passionate community. Marathon participants will start at 9:00, with the time displayed on their bib. There is a relaxation area and Pasta Party after the race at Vlahia Inn. EcoKids races have separate starts by age categories starting at 15:00. Registrations for the main races open on March 8, 2026, and close on May 1, 2026, subject to availability. Mountain routes, activities such as pasta party and floral ceremonies, with an emphasis on sustainability and eco-friendly practices.

The event includes three races: a half marathon of 21 km, an 11 km cross-country race, and a 7 km hike, each adapted for different types of participants, from experienced to those seeking a relaxing experience. Organizers emphasize safety, recovery, and socialization, providing facilities such as stretching sessions, post-run massages, camping, and activities for children. It is an excellent opportunity to enjoy nature, sport, and community in Sibiu County.

description: Tour de Tur is an annual mountain biking and trail running competition held in the Mujdeni Lake area, Orașu Nou Commune, Satu Mare County. The event offers diverse routes for all levels, from MTB marathon races to trail running, catering to both professional athletes and amateurs passionate about nature and adventure. The 20th edition in 2026 promises a complete sporting experience, with well-marked trails and significant elevation changes, set in a picturesque natural environment. Organizers invite all participants to register online and enjoy the competitive and friendly atmosphere of the event.
course_highlights: MTB Marathon Route: 44 km with an elevation gain of 1180 m
MTB Race Route: 34 km with an elevation gain of 930 m
Trail Running Half Marathon: 25 km with an elevation gain of 990 m
additional: The routes have significant elevation differences, from 184 m for Fun Run (6 km) to 1180 m for MTB Marathon (44 km). Registration of minors requires written consent from parents or guardians. The organizer is Societatea Carpatină Ardeleană - Satu Mare. Phone contact: +40-743-419443. Participation is exclusively online, and the event includes various routes from 6 km to marathon, adapted for different levels of preparation.

name: S24H
location: Parcul Copiilor „Ion Creangă”, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: S24H is an international ultra-marathon race held in the 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara, Romania. Participants run on a paved track of 1222.75 meters, illuminated at night, aiming to cover the greatest distance in 6, 12, or 24 hours. The event is open to both professionals and amateur endurance runners, offering a transformative experience and a significant mental and physical challenge. Additionally, there are races of 50 and 100 km, as well as a 12-hour relay for teams of four.
course_highlights: Paved track of 1222.75 meters in 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park
The track is illuminated at night for runners' safety
Two hydration and refreshment points along the course, with water, glucose, electrolytes, fruits, and snacks
additional: There are pavilions/tents along the course where runners can store their personal equipment, food, and sleeping bags. The participation kit can be picked up the day before, and a medical certificate is mandatory for all individual events, except for relays. The event includes a briefing for runners and a pasta party before the race. The event takes place on a paved and illuminated route, with the possibility to participate in multiple distance and time categories, making it an excellent opportunity to test physical and mental endurance.

name: Transylvania 100
location: Castelul Bran, Bran, Brașov County, Romania
description: Transylvania 100 is a mountain running event offering five different races, from a half marathon to a 100 km ultra-marathon, held in the Bucegi Mountains. The routes cross narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, with numerous ascents and descents, all starting and ending at Bran Castle, in the shadow of the legendary Dracula. The event is recognized as an UTMB Index race and promotes values such as respect, solidarity, and self-sufficiency in mountain running. Participants must have prior experience in mountain running for the longer races, and all finishers within the time limits receive a special souvenir.
course_highlights: Trails through narrow paths and ancient forests
Course across mountain plateaus and exposed ridges
Start and finish at Bran Castle area
additional: Technical SportHG shirts available until May 1, 2026, later replaced with neckwarmers. Participation limits and prior experience are mandatory for races over 20 km. All races are solo, with strict self-sufficiency rules between control points. The event includes races for different experience levels, with prizes for winners and medals for all finishers. Participation requires trail running experience, and registrations are made online, with limited spots.

name: SEMIMARATONUL EROILOR INVICTUS
description: The Invictus Heroes Half Marathon is an annual race organized in Timisoara, dedicated to heroes and supporting injured soldiers. The event promotes the spirit of victory and national values through sport, being part of the Invictus Romania project. The 4th edition continues the tradition of bringing together runners and supporters in an atmosphere of respect and solidarity. Participants can also contribute through donations to support injured soldiers.
course_highlights: Symbolic routes in the colors of the national flag: blue, yellow, and red
Event of solidarity and national commemoration
Organized by Invictus Romania, with a tradition of over a decade
additional: The event is part of a larger project, Invictus Romania, which includes other sports competitions and activities to support injured soldiers. Official T-shirts of the Invictus Heroes Half Marathon are available for supporters. No details were found regarding start times, distance options, or registration prices. The event takes place in May 2026 in Timisoara and includes a half marathon and commemorative activities.

The routes offer a combination of narrow trails, ancient forests, mountain plateaus, and exposed ridges, providing a unique experience for mountain enthusiasts. Races are open to solo competitors, with category prizes and special souvenirs for those who finish within the time limits.

description: The S24H international endurance running competition is an ultramarathon race held in the 'Ion Creangă' Children's Park in Timișoara, on a lit and paved loop of 1222.75 meters. Participants can choose from 6, 12, or 24-hour events, as well as 50 km and 100 km races, aiming to cover the greatest possible distance within the allotted time. The event is open to both professional and amateur runners, offering a transformative experience and the opportunity to test their physical and mental limits. Organization standards are high, with international recognition and dedicated facilities for participants.

Events of 6, 12, and 24 hours, plus 50 km and 100 km races

Paved route, night lighting, multiple events of duration and distance, suitable for both amateur and professional athletes.

name: Ultrabug
description: Ultrabug is a 3-day fully supported ultramarathon taking place on scenic mountain trails in the Carpathian Mountains of Romania, in the Fundu Moldovei area. The main route covers 100 km through mountain paths, mineral water streams, and villages with a rich culture, suitable for all fitness levels, including first-time ultra participants. The event also includes shorter alternative races such as Marathon XFun, Ultra XFun, and Fun Run to offer varied options for participants. After the race, participants are invited to an award ceremony and a traditional celebration with local food. Ultrabug is internationally recognized, offering iTRA points and being voted among the top 50 ultramarathons abroad.
course_highlights: 100 km route on mountain trails, mineral water streams, and traditional villages
Spectacular landscapes with green meadows and authentic sounds of bells and flowing waters
Alternative routes of 42 km + 8 km, 50 km + 8 km, and an 8 km race open to all ages
additional: Jacket/hoodie are included only for registrations made before May 1, 2026. The event offers 3 iTRA points for finishers. After the race, there is an award ceremony and a celebration with traditional food, including BBQ with polenta, cheese, and homemade bread. The race is open to runners, hikers, and walkers, with a minimum age of 18 for the 100 km race, and the 8 km race is open to all ages. The event includes accommodation at Casa Ileana in Fundu Moldovei, offers iTRA points, and has international participation.

The routes include the 10K Cross, Half Marathon, Marathon, and Ultramarathon, passing through the Tâmpa, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare massifs, offering stunning views and a unique combination of sport and nature. The event starts in the Council Square, passes by historical and natural landmarks, and is part of the Carpathian Circuit, providing ITRA and UTMB points. It is a celebration of health and sport, open to runners of all ages and experience levels.

The marathon route passes through spectacular landscapes, with refreshment and control points, and includes forest roads, unmarked trails, and viewpoints. Safety is a priority, with mandatory equipment checks and time limits for each category. The atmosphere is complemented by award ceremonies and a campfire after the race.
course_highlights: 42 km mountain route with a positive elevation gain of 2100 m
Spectacular views towards the Calimani Crest and risky viewpoints
Multiple refreshment, hydration, and control points along the route
additional: Kit pickup is on Friday, June 12 from 17:00 to 23:00 and Saturday, June 13 from 6:00 to 8:00 for the main categories. Mandatory equipment checks are conducted at the start. There are time limits for each category and intermediate control points. Participants' parking is organized on a forest road 1.3 km from the start/finish area. The award ceremony begins at 18:00, with the Mini MSD at 17:00, followed by a campfire. The event also includes races for families and mini races, with registration details available on the official website.

name: The Color Run Iași

tiers.label: tier_1
