Ability to participate in multiple sports and combinations (duathlon, triathlon)
Event held throughout 2026, with online progress monitoring
additional: The event is virtual and non-competitive, with the option to participate individually or in teams. Participants can choose multiple sports and routes, and progress is monitored online on the event platform. A finisher medal is awarded to all who complete the challenge. Registrations are open until August 31, 2026. The event includes an element of surprise and challenge, aimed at runners eager for unique experiences and testing their limits in an original way.

name: K3 ULTRA – GOLD BORDER RACE
description: K3 ULTRA - GOLD BORDER RACE is the first ultramarathon covering the border area of the Rhodope Mountains in Bulgaria. The race takes place at the end of September when nature is most picturesque and colorful. Participants can enjoy professionally organized routes with minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails, as well as special support along the course. The event is a qualifier for UTMB and awards points for ITRA ranking, and all finishers receive a medal and a special starter pack with a T-shirt and gifts.
course_highlights: Routes cover the border area of the Rhodope Mountains
Minimal asphalt sections, marked and secured trails
Stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruits, and Rhodope specialties
additional: Included starter pack with T-shirt, bib number, and gifts. Medical examination before participation is mandatory. Medical assistance and mountain insurance are provided. Stations with water, hot and cold drinks, fruits, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. Minimal asphalt sections on the course. Electronic result tracking. Information on accommodation, tents, and campers. Professional photo and video coverage. The race takes place at the end of September in Zlatograd and Madan, emphasizing nature, history, and adventure, with support for ecological causes.

name: K3 Ultra 2026
organizer: Клуб за спорт и туризъм К3 Ултра
description: K3 ULTRA is one of the largest ultramarathons in Bulgaria, held in the picturesque Rhodope Mountains. The race offers five different routes with varying lengths and elevation gains, all qualifying for the UTMB Index and earning points for the ITRA Ranking. Participants receive a starter pack with a T-shirt, bib number, and gifts, and the routes are marked and secured with minimal paved sections. The event provides medical assistance, support stations with food and drinks, as well as professional photography, creating an unforgettable experience amidst the fairy-tale Rhodope Mountains.
course_highlights: Five routes ranging from 13 to 100 km through the Rhodope Mountains
Total positive elevation gain up to 4170 m on the 100 km route
Qualifying race for UTMB with marked and secured routes
additional: The starter pack includes a T-shirt, bib number, gifts, and a special surprise. Medical examinations are mandatory and conducted on-site at no additional cost. Support stations offer water, hot and refreshing drinks, fruits, vegetables, and Rhodope specialties. The routes are marked and secured with minimal paved sections. The event provides mountain insurance and medical assistance during the race. No medical certificate is required; participants receive a starter pack with a T-shirt, transportation to the start points is available, the event supports green initiatives, and it is well organized.

name: Поморие Рън / Pomorie Run
description: Pomorie Run is part of the RUN BULGARIA series and offers an attractive long-distance race of 10.25 km and a short-distance race of 2023 meters for beginners. The course passes along the beach to the Black Sea and returns via a dirt road near Pomorie Lake, combining sea views and natural beauty. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and beginners, with children's athletics activities for young talents held before the race. Pomorie Run is a traditional race that attracts national champions and participants in Bulgaria's national team.
course_highlights: Long-distance 10.25 km along the beach to the Black Sea
Short-distance 2023 meters for beginners
Return via a dirt road near Pomorie Lake
additional: In the days before the race, children's athletics activities are held to recruit new talents for the athletics club "Athlet 2004" - Pomorie. The course includes running along the beach to the Black Sea and returning via a dirt road near Pomorie Lake; distances are 10.25 km and 2023 meters for beginners.

The event offers three distinct races: the 23 km Half Marathon, the Salamanders Race of 12 km, and the 1.6 km Circuit of the Ramparts, suitable for runners of all levels. The routes combine the challenge of mountain running with spectacular landscapes and historical elements, making them ideal for nature and history enthusiasts. Organizers ensure a complete experience with hydration points, timing, and an awards ceremony.

Natural landscapes and historical elements along the course
Three races adapted for different levels of preparation and age
additional: Kit pickup is on Friday, September 25, 2026, between 15:00 and 20:00 at the Sports Hall of the Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, 2026, between 07:30 and 11:30 at the start area at the Amphitheater in the Roman Castrum Porolissum. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, the 12 km race at 10:15, and the 1.6 km race at 13:00. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to modify the schedule until September 20, 2026. The event also includes the 23 km race with special conditions for minor participants and is held under estimated temperatures between 16-18°C. Rules for multiple races and details about registration and participant responsibilities are provided.

description: ASCOTID Trail Race is an off-road running competition organized annually in the Cornești Plateau area of Târgu Mureș. The event promotes physical activity for all age groups and is initiated by the Association of Diabetic Children and Youth Mureș (ASCOTID). The routes include a half marathon, 10 km and 5 km cross-country races, as well as races for children and families, offering an accessible yet challenging experience due to elevation differences. Participants can enjoy a beautiful natural setting and a friendly atmosphere, with social and health objectives.
course_highlights: Off-road trail in the Cornești Plateau area, the highest point of the city
Elevation gain of approximately 584 m for the half marathon and 256 m for the cross-country race
Various events: half marathon 21 km, 10 km cross, 5 km cross, races for children and families
additional: Online registrations can be made until September 14, 2026, after which registration is only possible one day before or on the day of the event, without a participation kit. The participation fee is paid by bank card or bank transfer, and registration is validated within 3 working days after payment confirmation. There is an option to transfer the registration to another participant in case of withdrawal, and changing the race category can be done with an additional fee of 50 lei until September 16, 2026. The races for children and families have short distances and a limited time for completion. Online registrations are open until September 15, 2024, with the possibility of on-site registration after this date; the event includes multiple race categories, and details about fees and registration procedures are available on the website.

name: „Alerg Pentru Tine” Trail Run
description: Run for You Trail Run is a charitable sporting event held in the picturesque forests of Bukovina, in the Sucevița area. The event aims to support palliative care patients at St. Luke's Hospital Sucevița and St. Mc. Zenovie Dr. Suceava, bringing joy and fulfilling the dreams of those in difficult moments. Participants can choose from three medium-difficulty races suitable for both experienced runners and less experienced ones, and are encouraged to run with heart and determination for a noble cause. The routes offer spectacular views of the Sucevița valley and the local monastery, and the atmosphere is one of solidarity and community support.
course_highlights: Trails through the forests of Bukovina with views over the Sucevița valley and the monastery
Steep climbs on Furcoi Hill and continuation along the Obcinei ridge
Control points, hydration, and feeding stations along the route
additional: The event offers three races: 20 km, 9 km, and a children's race. The routes are of medium difficulty, with control and hydration points. The time limit for the 9 km race is 2.5 hours. Participants are encouraged to run regardless of experience, and registrations close 4 days before the event. The closing festival is organized for all participants. Participation includes multiple race distances, online registration, and a festive closing event with music and traditional food.

name: ALBA IULIA CITY RACE Aleargă în cealaltă capitală!
location: Alba Carolina, Alba Iulia, Alba County, Romania
description: Alba Iulia City Race is a large-scale athletic event held in the heart of Alba Carolina Fortress, offering participants the chance to run through a remarkable historic setting. The competition includes several races, from a half marathon and 10 km cross to popular races and children's races, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the running community. The event is a running festival, combining a passion for sport with exploration and recognition of local values. Organizers emphasize a complete experience, with personalized kits, hydration points, electronic timing, and attractive prizes.
course_highlights: Routes through Alba Carolina Fortress, a restored and emblematic historic monument
Star Transmission Half Marathon of 21 km and Star Assembly Cross of 11 km
Support points with water, energy drinks, and fruits along the route

name: POROLISSUM TRAIL
location: Castrul Roman Porolissum, Moigrad, Sălaj, Romania
description: Porolissum Half Marathon is a mountain running event taking place on September 26, 2026, in Moigrad, Sălaj County. The main route of 23 km offers a spectacular experience, starting and ending in the heart of history at the Roman Castrum Porolissum. The event also includes races of 12 km and 1.6 km, suitable for both advanced runners and enthusiasts of nature and history. Organizers provide a friendly yet challenging atmosphere, with kit pickup days prior to and on race day.
course_highlights: Spectacular route with start and finish at the Roman Castrum Porolissum
Mountain running with historical and natural scenery
Multiple races: 23 km, 12 km, and 1.6 km for various skill levels
additional: Kit pickup will be on Friday, September 25, between 15:00 and 20:00 at the Sports Hall of the Avram Iancu Sports High School in Zalău, and on Saturday, September 26, between 07:30 and 11:30 at the start area near the Amphitheater in Castrum Roman Porolissum. The event officially begins at 09:00, with the 23 km race starting at 09:45, followed by the 12 km and 1.6 km races. The awards ceremony is scheduled for 14:00. The organizer reserves the right to modify the schedule until September 20, 2026. The event includes multiple race categories, with registration details and rules available on the official website.

name: TRASCĂU TRAIL RUN
description: Trascău Trail Run is a mountain race offering three events: marathon, half marathon, and cross-country, held in scenic landscapes around Rimetea, Alba. Participants will explore the natural beauty of the Trascău Mountains, with routes including challenging ascents, forests, gorges, and spectacular viewpoints. The event emphasizes the experience of running in nature, with courses combining physical challenge with picturesque scenery and local heritage. Organizers provide hydration and feeding stations, medals for those who finish within the time limit, and prizes for the top competitors.
course_highlights: The marathon route passes through the Cheile Plaiului Geological Reserve and Huda lui Papară Cave
The half marathon includes a steep ascent on Piatra Secuiului and crossing the Creasta de Cocoș
The cross-country offers an accessible mountain experience with peaceful landscapes in the forest near the Ardeșcheia massif
additional: Registration is free for persons with disabilities. There is a limited number of spots: 100 for the marathon, 250 for the half marathon, and 200 for the cross. Race kits are distributed in Cluj-Napoca and Rimetea in the days preceding the race. Technical briefings are held for each event before the start. Medals are awarded only to those who finish within the time limit. Participants are automatically entered into the post-award raffle, with mandatory presence for the draw. Routes for marathon, half marathon, and cross-country feature mountain and cultural landscapes, event scheduled for September 2026.

name: Международен шосеен пробег "Бягане на свободния дух Русе - Гюргево"
description: The International Road Race "Run of the Free Spirit Ruse - Giurgiu" is an annual event that brings together runners from Bulgaria and Romania for a race along the scenic route between the two cities. The race promotes sportsmanship and friendship between neighboring communities, offering a unique experience on the course. Participants can enjoy a well-organized event with international participation and support.
course_highlights: International route between Ruse and Giurgiu
Road course with scenic views
Race promoting friendship between Bulgaria and Romania

name: Buzău 21k
description: Buzău 21k is the first half marathon in Buzău County, organized by the Buzău Community Foundation, taking place on September 27, 2026. The event brings together the local community to promote movement, health, and charity, offering a vibrant running experience in the heart of the city. The route starts at the Buzău Athletics Stadium, crosses Crâng Park, and continues along the main boulevards and streets of the city, creating an atmosphere full of energy and joy. Buzău 21k is more than a sports competition; it is a manifesto for movement and community involvement.
course_highlights: Route starting from Buzău Athletics Stadium
Passing through Crâng Park and the main boulevards and streets of the city
Vibrant event in the heart of Buzău
additional: Sport Expo for kit pickup takes place on Saturday, September 26, from 10:00 to 20:00. There is a time limit for completing the first lap of the 21k race, with a cutoff time of 10:30. The awards ceremony occurs between 14:00 and 15:00 on race day. Includes races for children and events promoting health and community engagement.

description: Balkaniada 2026 is a mountain sky running race held in the heart of Central Balkan National Park, near the town of Karlovo. The race offers challenging routes with impressive natural scenery and diverse terrain, suitable for mountain runners and outdoor sports enthusiasts. Following the successful hosting of the World Sky Running Championships for veterans in 2025, Balkaniada is establishing itself as one of the leading mountain races in the Balkans. Participants can choose between several distances with varying length and elevation gain, providing a unique experience amidst wild nature.
course_highlights: Routes in Central Balkan National Park with a rich network of tourist trails
Distances with significant elevation gain: Vertical Kilometer (3.8 km / 830 m D+), 12 km / 700 m D+, 27 km / 1900 m D+, 44 km / 2570 m D+
Scenic views and challenging terrain, including mountain peaks and Balkan ridges
additional: From 05.01.26 to 31.01.26 inclusive, there is a 10% discount on registration with promo code "BALKANIADA10". The race includes several start times for different distances on October 4, 2026, in Karlovo. Registration is done through the Tracksport.live system. Distances: 3.8 km / 830 m D+, 12 km / 595 D+, 27 km / 1600 D+, 44 km / 2570 D+; registration with promo code; event in the mountains; various initiatives.

name: Шосеен пробег „Варна”
description: The Varna Road Race is a traditional competition held in the Sea Garden of Varna, attracting some of the best runners in Bulgaria. The event includes various distances suitable for men, women, and youth, offering opportunities for athletes from different age groups and clubs to showcase their talents. It is part of the sports calendar and promotes athletics in the region.
course_highlights: Course in the Sea Garden of Varna
Various distances for men, women, and youth
Participation of leading Bulgarian runners and clubs
additional: Held in the Sea Garden, various distances for men, women, juniors, and girls, results for different age groups

name: Last Man Standing
description: Last Man Standing is a unique endurance and strategy race where each 6.7 km lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour. Participants run at each fixed hour, and those who fail to finish in time or withdraw are eliminated. The race continues until only one runner remains standing, testing the physical and mental limits of the competitors. The event is part of Zalău Ultra Trail, a platform that unites sport, community, and nature.
course_highlights: Predefined 6.7 km course per lap
Each lap must be completed within a maximum of one hour
Immediate elimination for delay or withdrawal
additional: The race takes place in hourly rounds, each lap starting at the exact hour following the completion of the previous one. It is a test of mental and physical endurance, where the adversaries are time, the course, and one's own mind. The event includes distances such as 12.5 km, 24 km, 44 km, and 103 km, promoting values of solidarity and respect for nature.

description: Veverița Night Run is a night mountain running race in Bukovina, held in the town of Vatra Dornei. The event offers two medium difficulty races, 12 km and 22 km, on predominantly mountain trail routes, with forest sections and open meadows. The start and finish are at the base of the Veverița slope, and the route reaches Vârful Diecilor, at an altitude of 1301 meters. Participants must be prepared for mountain running at night, with appropriate equipment, including a headlamp and mobile phone.
course_highlights: Medium difficulty route with 95-100% mountain trail
80% forest and 20% open meadows on both races
The route reaches Vârful Diecilor, at 1301m elevation
additional: Participants must have a mobile phone with a charged battery and a headlamp with spare batteries. Equipment for adverse weather conditions, such as a long-sleeve shirt or waterproof poncho, is mandatory. There are hydration points and two feeding stations, at the start and at Vârful Diecilor. Medical assistance is provided by mountain rescuers, with no stationary ambulance at the start/finish. The participation fee is non-refundable in case of withdrawal. Registration becomes valid after payment confirmation. Minors require a parental or guardian authorization. mountain, nocturnal, hydration and feeding points, Salvamont assistance, strict participation rules

name: Harvest Run
description: Harvest Run is a community sports event that promotes a healthy lifestyle through running, aimed at all ages and fitness levels. The event takes place in Vladimirescu, Arad, and includes races for children, families, and amateur or experienced runners. Each edition supports social causes, turning running into an act of solidarity and community support. Participants enjoy a friendly and inclusive atmosphere, with routes adapted for all ages and performance levels.
course_highlights: Varied routes: half marathon 21 km, sprint 10 km, super sport 5 km, family race 1 km, and races for children
Event for all ages, from 6 years old to adults and families
Location in Vladimirescu, Arad, with an active community and support for social causes
additional: The community gathers every Tuesday at 19:00 for group training at Harvest Arad Church. The event supports social and educational projects, including initiatives for children and teenagers from disadvantaged backgrounds. The event features various race categories and has a charitable purpose, supporting social and community causes.

name: Brașov Running Festival
description: Brașov Running Festival is a top road running event that brings thousands of runners to Brașov, from amateurs to elite athletes, in an atmosphere full of energy, music, and fun. The festival includes various races, from 5 km for beginners, children's races, to the tRUNsylvania 10K, the only road race in Romania certified with the World Athletics Elite Label. The event takes place on the streets of the Tractorul neighborhood in Brașov and offers a complete experience with cheering zones, live performances, and TV broadcasts. It is a celebration of running that combines athletic performance with community joy.
course_highlights: tRUNsylvania 10K - emblematic race, certified with the World Athletics Elite Label
Various routes: 5K Open, Wheelchair Race 5K, Kids Races, Fun Race 3K, Trail to Road
Cheering zones with live performances throughout the course
additional: Public spectator access is free throughout the event. The tRUNsylvania 10K race is broadcast live on national TV channels and online. All participants receive the official race T-shirt provided by the technical sponsor Joma. A locker room is available for personal belongings, but bulky items are not accepted. Race bibs are personal and mandatory throughout the race. There is a 5 km race earlier in the day, with routes of approximately 3.5 km in the Tractorul neighborhood, Brașov.

name: UVT Liberty Marathon
location: Bd. V. Pârvan 4, Timișoara, Timiș County, Romania
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition organized in Timișoara, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the freedom to discover oneself through movement. The event offers races for all levels, from children to experienced runners, with distances ranging from 200 meters to a full marathon of 42 km. The UVT Liberty Marathon community is dedicated to supporting and motivating participants to reach their potential and enjoy running in a friendly and energetic environment. The routes are designed to challenge and inspire, and the atmosphere is one of support and freedom.
course_highlights: Full marathon route of 42 km for experienced runners
Half marathon of 21 km for those who accept half the challenge
Cross country and children's races, with distances from 200 m to 1 km
additional: The event includes races for all ages and experience levels, with age categories from 4 years to adults. Facilities such as control points, medical staff, and eco-friendly toilets are available. Training programs for distances of 5, 10.5, 21, and 42 km are created by an experienced university coach. The maximum duration for the marathon is 6 hours, and for the half marathon 3 hours. Participants can choose from several distances, including marathon, half marathon, relay, and children's races; the event promotes freedom and health in the community; registrations and race details are available on the official website.

name: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv
description: LIEBHERR Business Run Plovdiv is a corporate relay race and team-building event held at the LIEBHERR factory in Plovdiv. The competition includes teams of 4 people, with each participant running 4 km, completing two laps around a flat 2 km route. It is the largest corporate run in Southern Bulgaria, combining sport, fun, and charity. The event has been held since 2017 in Plovdiv and attracts companies from across the country.
course_highlights: Flat route around the LIEBHERR factory
A 2 km lap that each participant runs twice
Relay race with teams of 4 people
additional: Each company can add laser engraving to the medals for an additional fee. There is an option for a branded tent in the relay exchange zone. Participants receive start packages with gifts and medals. The event supports a charitable cause, with donations made directly to the beneficiary. Corporate relay race, team building, online registration, charitable initiatives, prizes, and certificates for companies.

description: Neofit Rilski Marathon and Cycling 2026 offers a unique adventure with routes passing through the beautiful Bulgarian nature from the village of Neofit Rilski to the Ovech fortress. The competitions include running and cycling over various distances, starting and ending at the Historical Park. Participants will face challenges with different elevation gains and control times, suitable for various levels of preparation. A children's run with treats is planned for kids. The event is suitable for sports and nature enthusiasts seeking a serious challenge and adventure.
course_highlights: Routes with a total positive and negative elevation gain of up to 870 meters
Start and finish at the Historical Park
Variety of distances for running and cycling - 42 km, 25 km, 13 km, and children's run
additional: Children's run of 700 meters with treats for all kids. Control times for different distances range from 2 to 7 hours. Mandatory equipment and participation declarations are required. All finishers receive a unique medal. Online registration, control points, GPX tracks, medical coverage, and support zones along the route. The start is at 9:00 AM, awards ceremony begins at 2:30 PM, and closing is at 5:00 PM.

name: Crosul Regina Maria
location: Sala Sporturilor Horia Demian, Cluj-Napoca, Cluj County, Romania
description: The Regina Maria Run is a running event organized in Cluj-Napoca, bringing together the local running community for an energetic competition full of sports spirit. The route starts from the Horia Demian Sports Hall area and offers participants a pleasant experience with a friendly atmosphere and well-organized logistics. The event is supported by official sponsors and partners, ensuring smooth execution and facilities for runners. It is an excellent opportunity for athletes of all levels to enjoy outdoor running and connect with other enthusiasts.
course_highlights: Start and kit pickup at Horia Demian Sports Hall, side entrance from the tram line
Accessible and well-marked urban route in Cluj-Napoca
Friendly atmosphere and support from the local running community
additional: Kit pickup is at Horia Demian Sports Hall, side entrance from the tram line. There are videos from the previous edition to see the atmosphere and route. The event is part of the IndividuALL Running Series and is supported by official sponsors and partners. The event takes place on outdoor routes along the Someș River, with kit pickup at Horia Demian Sports Hall.

description: Mârzeşti Trail Run is an annual Cross Country running competition held in the Breazu area, Rediu commune, Iași County, with start and finish in front of the forest ranger station in Mârzeşti Forest. The varied routes include wooded areas, meadows, forest and agricultural roads, offering a unique outdoor running experience with flat sections, descents, and ramps. The event promotes outdoor sports and supports local social causes, providing an opportunity for joy and gathering for running enthusiasts. The half marathon distance and other races are suitable for different training levels, and the organization includes hydration points and referees on the course.
course_highlights: Routes combining forest roads, meadows, and agricultural roads
Varied terrain with flat sections, descents, and ramps
Hydration points at km 3, 5, and 8.5, used also for the half marathon
additional: The routes are supervised by referees and photographers, and traffic is not closed. The event supports local social causes through voluntary donations. Warming up before running is recommended. There are control points 200 meters from start/finish for all races. Trails include forest and meadow paths, Cross Country race, social involvement, promotion of nature and a healthy lifestyle.

name: Hercules Maraton
description: Hercules Marathon is a mountain running event organized in the Cerna Valley, Băile Herculane, by the Alternative Sports Club Timișoara. The competition includes Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km) races held on mountain trails that cross the Cerna Mountains and connect the 39 hamlets in the area. It is one of the first mountain marathons in the region, offering an authentic trail running experience in spectacular natural landscapes. The event is dedicated to runners passionate about mountain terrain and adventure.
course_highlights: Mountain trails crossing the Cerna Mountains
Connects 39 hamlets in the Cerna Valley area
Distances of Marathon (44 km) and Half Marathon (22 km)
additional: The routes pass through scenic areas and may include varied mountain terrain; registration details are not specified

name: Bucharest Marathon
description: Raiffeisen Bank Bucharest Marathon is an iconic sporting event held annually in Bucharest, offering races for all levels of runners. The courses include the full marathon of 42 km, the half marathon of 21 km, the 10 km race, the popular race, and the 4x relay, all starting from Constitution Square. The event is known for its vibrant atmosphere, community support, and involvement in charitable causes. Participants can experience an urban route passing through important points of the capital, with hydration and support stations along the way.
course_highlights: Urban route through emblematic points of Bucharest
Variety of races: marathon, half marathon, 10 km, popular race, and 4x relay
Start and finish in Constitution Square
additional: Participation kits can be picked up before the race at the designated location. The event includes hydration and medical support stations along the route. There are pacemakers for the main races. After the race, participants receive prizes and medals. Organizers support charitable causes through partner NGOs. The event features charitable partnerships, exhibitions, and prizes for winners, with registration and kit pickup details available on the official website.

description: Azuga Trail Race powered by JYSK is an annual mountain running event held in the town of Azuga and the Baiului Mountains, Romania. The event offers passionate runners a unique experience on four spectacular routes with views of Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare. Participants can enjoy nature, physical and mental challenges, as well as an atmosphere full of adrenaline and competitive spirit. It is an opportunity to test your limits and meet people with the same passions.
course_highlights: Four mountain routes with views of Bucegi, Postăvaru, and Piatra Mare
Routes in the Baiului Mountains with support points offering water, energy drinks, and fruits
Different start times for the main races and children's races, including special routes with cable car transport
additional: The race kit includes a personalized bib, personalized products, individual timing with chip, support points with water and fruits, finisher medals, cash prizes and sports equipment, surprise prize draws, ITRA/UTMB points where applicable, official photo and video album. Cable car transport is included for the Family Walk & Run and Urechea Run. The awards ceremony is at 17:00, with a SuperParty on Saturday evening featuring DJ Cătălin Sănătescu. Routes with significant elevation differences, impressive mountain scenery, a festive atmosphere, and activities for the whole family.

name: Маратон "Хайдушки Пътеки"
organizer: КЛУБ СТОТЕ ВОЙВОДИ - ФОНДАЦИЯ СТАРИЯ БРЯСТ
description: The Haidushki Pateki Marathon is a unique race held in the Sinite Kamani Nature Park in the Central Balkan Mountains. The course passes through a historic rocky massif with alpine relief, fortified with 14 ancient and medieval fortresses used by hajduks as refuges. The route follows ancient paths used by the hajduks and offers an opportunity to enjoy the nature and history of the area. The event takes place in the last week of October, providing diverse weather conditions and varying levels of difficulty each year.
course_highlights: The course passes through 14 ancient and medieval fortresses
Alpine type relief with exposed rocky peaks, ridges, and steep slopes
The route follows ancient hajduk paths and hiking trails
additional: The course passes through historic fortresses and natural landmarks, held in the last week of October, with variations in weather conditions and difficulty.

The event includes two main distances: a 7 km cross-country race and a 22 km half marathon, held on scenic routes in the Făget area. This competition is a cherished tradition among the local running community, being in its 15th edition, and promises a pleasant and challenging experience for runners of all levels.
course_highlights: 7 km cross-country trail in nature
22 km half marathon with scenic landscapes
Marked routes supported by Runners Club Cluj-Napoca
additional: The routes are marked and a GPX file is available for the half marathon. The event is organized by Runners Club, which also offers free group training sessions in Cluj-Napoca. There are official partners and supporters of the race. The event also includes other trail races and related activities, providing an opportunity to discover the natural beauty of the area and participate in a community sports activity.

description: The 'Saturday Running' Half Marathon in Călărași is an iconic sporting event for the local community, bringing together amateur and professional runners in a friendly and motivating competition. The course takes place in Central Park, offering a pleasant and accessible experience for all participants. The atmosphere is one of support and camaraderie, with dedicated facilities for runners' comfort, including tents for relaxation and first aid. The event promotes personal progress and the sporting spirit, providing an excellent opportunity for socialization and testing endurance.
course_highlights: Course in Central Park (Parcul Mare) in Călărași
Metal tents for refuge and first aid provided by Expodom
Friendly atmosphere and mutual support among participants
additional: Participants can run a 5 km race in Central Park near Queen restaurant. Registration confirmation is done via email after completing online payment through MobilPay (Netopia). Organizers offer a gift voucher for registration and provide tents for relaxation and first aid. The refund and return policy is available on the website. The event includes a half marathon and a 5 km race, with registrations and results available online, as well as gift options for participants.

name: Black Sea Trail
description: Black Sea Trail is a mountain running event held in the area of Varna, Bulgaria, with three different distances suitable for runners of various levels. The routes offer a variety of terrains and beautiful views of the Black Sea, combining challenging ascents and descents. The event is a great opportunity for nature and mountain running enthusiasts to enjoy sport and nature together.
course_highlights: 38 km with 1100 m positive elevation gain
26 km with 700 m positive elevation gain
11 km with 330 m positive elevation gain
additional: The event is related to mountain running and tourism, and is expected to take place in October 2026 in Varna, Bulgaria.

name: Emine ultra
description: Emine Ultra is a mountain running race that combines the beauty of the mountains and the sea in the Eleni area. The race offers four distances - 4K, 12K, 28K, and 50K, suitable for runners of different levels. The course passes through picturesque natural trails and provides a unique experience in nature. The event is part of the international Kom-Emine route and attracts runners seeking challenge and inspiration.
course_highlights: Mountain and sea landscapes
Part of the international Kom-Emine route
Various distances from 4 to 50 km
additional: The event is scheduled for October 18, 2026, and includes different distances suitable for runners with various levels of preparation. The routes pass through scenic natural areas in Eleni.

name: 34-ти Мемориал „Митето”
description: The 'Dimitar Vurbanov - Mito' race in Koynare is a traditional athletics event with over 30 years of history, including half marathons, road runs, and track tournaments. In recent years, a race walking tournament has also been held, attracting athletes from various cities in Bulgaria. Organizers from SKA 'Spartak - Koynare' provide professional organization and competitions for all ages. The event is known for the participation of the best Bulgarian runners and race walkers.
course_highlights: Traditional race with over 30 years of history
Includes half marathons, road runs, and track tournaments
Race walking tournament with a 1 km lap
additional: The race walking tournament takes place on a 1 km lap. Athletes of different ages and from various cities participate in the event. Among the judges is the national record holder for 20 km race walking, Lyubomir Ivanov. Full results and photographic material are published on the event's Facebook page. Race walking tournament, participants from all over Bulgaria, 1 km course, first time in history in Koynare.

name: Надбягване в Източни Родопи
description: Running race in Eastern Rhodopes is an ultramarathon held in the area of Krumovgrad, known for its rich biodiversity and mystical history. The routes pass through unique natural phenomena and megalithic monuments such as Sheitan Dere and Kovil, offering challenging technical descents and ascents. The event is suitable for both experienced runners and amateurs who want to enjoy the wild nature and adventurous spirit of the Eastern Rhodopes. Organizers provide marking, medals, time tracking, and photographers, and participants can run with pets, with encouragement to use reusable water bottles.
course_highlights: Routes pass through megalithic monuments like Kovil and natural phenomena like Sheitan Dere
Technical descents and ascents with moderate elevation gain
Opportunity to participate with pets with water and treats provided at checkpoints
additional: Organizers provide marking, medals, time tracking, and photographers. Participants can run with pets, for which water and treats are provided at checkpoints. Use of reusable bottles or cups for water is recommended to reduce plastic waste. Routes: 67 km, 37 km, 22 km, 4 km; registration and participation with support for pets; environmental requirements.

name: Национален шампионат по крос кънтри
description: The National Cross Country Championship in Koynare is a prestigious race that gathers athletes from all over Bulgaria for competitive runs in a natural and challenging environment. The event offers opportunities for both young and experienced runners, taking place on diverse terrain suitable for the cross country discipline. Organizers provide professional timing and live results, ensuring accuracy and transparency in the rankings. The event is part of the Race Timing BG calendar, which offers modern registration and timing services.
course_highlights: Terrain with natural obstacles and diverse relief
Suitable for all age groups and skill levels
Professional timing with RFID technology
additional: Online registration with personalized emails and real-time participant list. Use of certified timing equipment and live results optimized for mobile devices and computers. The date is 2026-10-24, the race will be held in Koynare, organized by Race Timing BG, with the course in the area around the town.

name: Timișoara City Marathon
description: UVT Liberty Marathon is a running competition held in Timisoara, offering races on various distances from 1 km up to the full marathon of 42 km. The event promotes freedom and community spirit, inviting runners of all levels to participate and push their limits. With a solid tradition and dedicated training programs, the marathon is an inspiring and energizing experience for all participants.
course_highlights: Various distances: 1 km, 4 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, and 42 km
Event organized in Timisoara, with urban routes
Strong community and personalized training programs
additional: There are training programs for all main distances (5 km, 10.5 km, 21 km, 42 km) created by an experienced university coach. The event includes free short-distance races for children. Relay races for the marathon and half marathon are also available. Participants can benefit from marathon training programs, including plans for beginners and intermediates, as well as tips for equipment and physical preparation.

name: RUN IASI
description: Run Iași is a running event that brings together students, teachers, and residents of Iași to celebrate movement, education, and civic spirit. The race is a declaration of belonging and solidarity, transforming each kilometer into a symbol of an active and healthy community. Participants enjoy an energetic and united sporting experience in a vibrant urban setting.
course_highlights: Urban route through the city of Iași
A 10 km race for runners of all levels
Community atmosphere and civic spirit
additional: The event includes 5 km and 10 km races, with online registration, and promotes health, education, and solidarity in Iași

name: TIMIȘOARA CITY MARATHON
description: Timișoara City Marathon is a sporting event dedicated to both amateurs and experienced runners, held in the heart of Timișoara. The 42.2 km marathon starts from Otelec and ends in Victory Square, offering a unique experience through the story of Eugeniu de Savoya's arrival. The half marathon and cross-country races feature varied routes passing through the city's markets, parks, and historic neighborhoods, highlighting the local beauty and heritage. The event also includes related activities such as workshops, Pasta Party, and a special anniversary race "106 pentru POLI".
course_highlights: The marathon starts outside the city, from Otelec, and finishes in Victory Square
The half marathon combines markets and parks in the Fabric district along the Bega River
Cross-country races pass through parks along the Bega Canal and the Fabric neighborhood
additional: Kit distribution takes place at the UPT Rectorate in Victory Square. The marathon begins with a bus departure at 06:30 from Victory Square to Otelec. Energizing products (bar + gel) are included only for the 42 km and 21 km races. The technical T-shirt and cotton T-shirt can be purchased during registration. The event includes workshops, Pasta Party, and the anniversary race "106 pentru POLI" on October 29, 2026, at Știința Stadium. Participants can choose from several race categories, including workshops and a pasta party.

name: ZARA ULTRA Trail run 2026
organizer: СНЦ Клуб за колоездене и туризъм „Зарата“

tiers.label: tier_2

description: ZARA ULTRA TRAIL RUN & XCM CYCLING / Easter Marathon 2026 is an exciting sports event held in Ayazmoto Park, Stara Zagora. Organized by the Non-Profit Association Cycling and Tourism Club "Zarata" with the support of the Municipality of Stara Zagora and the Sarnena Gora Tourist District, the competition includes mountain running and cycling with various distances. Participants can enjoy diverse routes suitable for both amateurs and elite athletes. The event offers tiered participation fees and provides registration and briefing on the day of the race.
course_highlights: Mountain running with distances of 5 km, 11 km, 21 km, 32 km, and 38 km (ultra)
Mountain cycling with eBike MTB up to 27 km/h on the 38 km ultra route
Location: Ayazmoto Park, Stara Zagora, near the badminton courts
additional: Registration and distribution of start numbers from 07:00 to 08:00. Briefing before the start. Awards at 17:00 for both disciplines. Mandatory valid "Accident" insurance for the day of the event. Cyclists must wear a helmet and use an upright bicycle. Payment is only via bank transfer or at an EasyPay cash desk after online registration. Multiple running and cycling distances, including MTB and e-bike options, with online registration and payment.

name: Beiuș Running Day
price_range: 10 km: 120 RON, Half Marathon: 150 RON, 2 km și cursa pentru copii: gratuit
description: Beiuș Running Day is an annual running event offering four races suitable for all ages and experience levels, including free races for children and beginners. The routes include a 2 km race, a children's race, a 10 km race, and a half marathon of 21.1 km, held on forest trails and paved streets in Beiuș, Bihor. The event emphasizes safety, a friendly environment, and a competitive atmosphere, with podium prizes and surprises for participants. It is an excellent opportunity for families and runners of all levels to enjoy sport and nature in an organized and friendly setting.
course_highlights: Forest trails with natural paths for the 10 km and half marathon races
Children's race on completely safe, paved routes closed to traffic
Hydration points and safety measures on all routes
additional: The children's race is free, intended for children between 4 and 13 years old, with age categories and distances ranging from 250m to 1000m, on completely safe routes closed to traffic. Participation of children requires the mandatory presence of a parent or guardian throughout the race. Medals, diplomas, and product prizes are offered to all participants, and routes for adults include hydration points and are clearly marked. Registration deadline: October 26, 2025; event date: October 31, 2026; varied routes including urban areas and parks; the event promotes health and physical activity within the community.

name: Hațeg Royal Trail
description: Hațeg Royal Trail is a mountain race held in the picturesque landscape of Hațeg, Hunedoara, offering varied routes for runners of all levels. The event includes a marathon, half marathon, 12 km cross-country, 6 km race, children's race, family run, and a race dedicated to people with special abilities "And I CAN!". The routes pass through forests, hills, and historical sites such as Hațeg Royal Fortress, providing a technical and spectacular experience. The organization is appreciated for clear markings and a friendly atmosphere, with attractive prizes and support from the local community.
course_highlights: Routes through forests and hills with technical ascents and descents
Passing through Hațeg Royal Fortress, an emblematic historical site
Varied landscapes including Lunca de Jos, Tronul Străbunilor, and Covragiu village
additional: Kit pickup is between 18:00 and 20:00 on the day before the race. The start for the 6 km cross-country, 12 km cross-country, and half marathon is at 10:00 AM, while the Family run and "And I CAN!" race begin at 15:00. Registrations for children's races and the Family run can also be made on-site, subject to availability. It is recommended to choose a T-shirt size smaller than usual due to manufacturing tolerance. The event includes cash prizes and gifts, totaling approximately 30,000 RON in 2025, and promotes ecotourism and outdoor activities in the Tara Hategului area.

name: Първа Пушка TRAIL 2026
description: First Cannon Trail is a mountain running race held in the historic town of Koprivshtitsa, combining sport, nature, and history. The competition offers three routes of varying length and elevation gain, passing through picturesque forest trails, open meadows, and reaching Bogan Peak - the highest point of the Central Mountain. Participants can enjoy beautiful views of the Rhodope Mountains and the Balkan Mountains, as well as the patriotic spirit of the cobbled streets and authentic old houses of Koprivshtitsa.
course_highlights: Routes through picturesque forest trails and open meadows
Climb to Bogan Peak (1604 m), the highest point of the Central Mountain
Majestic views of the Rhodope Mountains and the Balkan Mountains
additional: The start is from the central square '20th April' in Koprivshtitsa. Starting packages are received the day before or on the day of the race. Timing is with a chip on the back of the race number. It is mandatory to carry your own water container (minimum 0.5 liters), as no plastic bottles are distributed along the course. Recommended gear includes comfortable mountain running shoes, aluminum foil, and a mobile phone with an extra battery. Live results are published on the website Tracksport.live. The routes include a climb to Bogan Peak, starting in the center of Koprivshtitsa, medal provision, timing, insurance, food, and support drinks. Registration is online via the Tracksport platform. The event is suitable for children under 13 with a guardian.

name: Băneasa Forest Run
description: Băneasa Forest Run is a 100% trail race in Băneasa Forest, Bucharest, which started in 2018 and has grown to over 2,400 participants. The event offers four categories: half marathon, 11 km cross, fast 6 km run, and a non-competitive Family Run of 3 km, suitable for all running levels. The race emphasizes the joy of running in nature and spending time with family, organized by a passionate running team. Participants benefit from group training sessions with different paces, coordinated by coaches, to prepare optimally for race day.
course_highlights: 100% trail route in Băneasa Forest
Various categories: half marathon, 11 km, 6 km, and Family Run 3 km
Organized group training sessions with different paces
additional: Organized group training sessions with different paces and coordinators. The Family Run is a non-competitive event for families. The event supports social causes through partnerships with the Magic Association and the Day of Good Association. It includes multiple race categories, details about the route and instructions for participants, as well as support for social causes.

name: Балкански шампионат по крос кънтри
organizer: Балканска атлетика (АБАФ), атлетически клуб „Спартак“ – Койнаре, община Червен бряг
description: The Balkan Cross Country Championship 2026 will be held in Koynare, Bulgaria, on November 7th. The event is organized by the local athletic club "Spartak" - Koynare, in cooperation with the city municipality, Cherven Bryag Municipality, and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. The course is designed around the stadium and the buildings of the athletic club, near the city center, and will host over 600 athletes and guests. Koynare is an established host of running events with a long-standing tradition and experience in organizing sports activities.
course_highlights: The course is around the stadium and the athletic club buildings in the center of Koynare
Within a 20 km radius, there are several luxury hotels for accommodation
Koynare is an active organizer of running events with a tradition of over 30 years
additional: Expected participation of over 600 athletes, team representatives, referees, organizers, and fans. The event is part of the sports calendar of Balkan athletics and the Bulgarian Athletics Federation. At the end of October 2026, Koynare will also host the national cross country championship as preparation for the Balkan championship. The course is around the stadium and the athletic club buildings, with hotels within a 20 km radius for over 600 participants and guests.

description: istritaXscape is a mountain running event organized by the Legendary Sports Sports Club Association, held on the hills, trails, and forest roads in the Istrița hill area and the Sărata-Monteoru resort. The routes offer a unique experience, crossing natural and historical landscapes, with traces of the Dacians, Romans, and prehistoric life. The event is dedicated to both amateurs and professionals, promoting outdoor activity and passion for mountain running. Participants can enjoy three different races, each with its own challenges and beauties.
course_highlights: Trails on the hills and paths in the Istrița and Sărata-Monteoru area
Scenic views of the Monteoru resort and Buzău city
Marked routes through forests, forest roads, and historical zones with Dacian and Roman traces
additional: The start package includes a race number, a medal for those who finish the race within the indicated time, revitalization points and support along the route, isotonic drinks at the start/finish and on the course, rankings and electronic diploma, filming and audio/video editing. The Half Marathon and Marathon routes are intended for participants over 18 years old, while Fun Run is open to children between 8 and 17 years old, who must be accompanied by a parent registered for the same event. Routes of 3 km, 7.5 km, 12.5 km, and 20 km; mountain running event in nature; participation scheduled for November 7, 2026.

name: The Cactus Run
description: The Cactus Run is one of the largest classic races within the RunBG Trail Series, held in the village of German, Sofia. The event offers a unique experience in nature with diverse routes suitable for runners of different levels. The courses pass through scenic trails and present challenges that will delight both amateurs and experienced runners. Organized by Trail Series, the race is part of a seasonal series that gathers runners from across the country.
course_highlights: Trails in nature around the village of German
Scenic paths and diverse terrain
Suitable for runners of various levels
additional: The event takes place on November 8, 2026, from 11:00 to 15:00 in the village of German. Organized by Trail Series. Google Maps directions are available for the location. No specific prices or registration categories have been published on the pages at this time. Trail race with diverse terrain, including asphalt and paths; registration details are not specified.

name: BUCHAREST 21K
description: Bucharest 21k is a running race that invites you to discover the capital of Romania in a unique way, through running. The route is flat, smooth, and ideal for setting personal records, crossing green parks and combining old architecture with the modern energy of the city. The event is suitable for both elite runners and passionate amateurs, offering a vibrant and dynamic atmosphere in the heart of Bucharest. It is a perfect opportunity to explore a lively European city still undiscovered by the masses.
course_highlights: Flat and smooth route, ideal for personal records
Green parks integrated into the route
Unique combination of old architecture and modern energy
additional: The event is part of the YOLO Events series, which promotes an active and healthy lifestyle. Participants can support charitable causes through personal fundraising pages. The atmosphere is energizing, and the event is open to both elite runners and amateurs. The route includes hydration points every 5 km, and a lively atmosphere characteristic of Romania's capital.

name: Emenski Canyon Run
description: Emen Canyon Run 2026 is a mountain running event held in the village of Emen, Veliko Tarnovo Province. The competition offers three routes of different lengths and elevation gain - 8 km with 360 meters of positive elevation, 16 km with 720 meters, and 24 km with 1100 meters. Participants will enjoy marked trails, support stations, and professional timing. The event includes a medal and souvenir for all finishers, as well as race photos.
course_highlights: Three routes of 8 km, 16 km, and 24 km
Mountain terrain with positive elevation from 360 to 1100 meters
Marked trails and support stations along the route
additional: Registration and collection of start packages from 08:00 to 11:00. Technical briefing at 10:20 at the start. Starts: 24 km at 10:30, 16 km at 11:00, 8 km at 11:45. Medal and souvenir for all finishers. Timing and race number for all participants. Event photography. Trail running with various distances, registration, medals, support stations, and technical information for participants.

description: The Hoia GlobalLogic Run is a running race organized in Cluj-Napoca, offering participants the opportunity to run on cool trails in Hoia Forest. The event includes several running categories with distances of 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family event, suitable for all ages and fitness levels. The organizers, Runners Club, promote a friendly atmosphere and support the local running community. Participants can enjoy a natural route, away from asphalt, in a picturesque and healthy setting.
course_highlights: Trail on cool paths in Hoia Forest
Various distances: 15 km, 7 km, 3 km, and a family event
Event organized in nature, away from asphalt
additional: The event includes registration packages with a T-shirt and race number. There are categories for all ages, including a dedicated family race. The route is on natural forest trails, providing a trail running experience in nature. The start takes place in the evening, offering a special night run atmosphere. The participation fee includes a medal, timing, and medical assistance, with online registration only and a registration deadline until June 13, 2026.

name: CROSUL 15 NOIEMBRIE
description: The 15 November Run is an annual sporting event organized in Brașov, commemorating the Anti-Communist Uprising of November 15, 1987, by workers at the Roman Truck Factory. The main race is a 5-kilometer road run held along the historic route of the uprising, open to all running enthusiasts. There are also races dedicated to children, with distances adapted to their age, to promote movement and team spirit. The event is organized by the Brașov City Hall in partnership with the 15 November 1987 Brașov Association and the Together for Movement Sports Club.
course_highlights: Historical 5 km route through the streets of the 1987 Brașov Uprising
Urban course on roads through Brașov, including historical and cultural points
Races for children with distances between 250m and 1.2km, adapted to age groups
additional: Registrations are free and limited to 1800 participants (1500 adults and 300 children). Kit pickup is available the day before at Sport Guru Brașov Store between 15:30 and 20:00. The race starts inside the Roman industrial park, exactly from the former Section 440 of the Truck Factory, the place where the uprising erupted. Running through the streets of Brașov, 5 km route, races for all ages, commemorative event, organized in November 2025.

name: Mаратон Бургас
description: The Burgas Marathon is an inspiring sporting event that combines the seaside atmosphere, sports, and community. With a variety of distances - 5 km, 10.5 km, half marathon, and full marathon - the event is suitable for both beginners and experienced runners. The course passes through the most beautiful and iconic parts of Burgas, including the Sea Garden and the promenade, offering a fast and scenic run with an internationally certified route. The organization is of high standard, with support along the entire course and group registration options.
course_highlights: Certified by World Athletics and AIMS route with international recognition
City circuit course with 100% asphalt and minimal elevation
The route passes through the Sea Garden and the promenade of Burgas
additional: Start and finish are located in the pedestrian zone on Alexander St. and Aleko Bogoridi St. in Burgas. The route has a minimal elevation gain of about +50 meters per lap, making it suitable for personal records. Group registration is available for teams of over 5 participants with preferential conditions. GPX tracks for all distances are available for download. The organizer reserves the right to change start times if necessary. Various distances, online registration, event in Burgas.

name: XL kmrun - Бонсови поляни
description: XL kmrun - Bonsovi Polani is a November race from the XLkmrun calendar, organized by 5kmrun. It takes place in the area of Lyulin Mountain and the iconic location "Bonsovi Polani" on the outskirts of Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances - short, medium, and long, allowing runners with different training levels and ambitions to participate. The event is part of a series of races offering diverse routes and conditions for running in the nature around Sofia.
course_highlights: The course passes through the Lyulin Mountain area and the Bonsovi Polani location
Choice of three distances - short, medium, and long
Natural and iconic location on the outskirts of Sofia
additional: The race will be held in a natural environment with mountain terrain, with exact registration details and fees not specified. The date is November 22, 2026.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is a mountain running event celebrating Romania on National Day, held in Cluj-Napoca. In its 9th edition in 2026, the race offers various routes, including the 50 km ultramarathon, team races, half marathon, cross country, and children's races. Participants can support one of Romania's nine historical regions, enjoying scenic landscapes and a friendly atmosphere. The main 50 km route passes through natural and urban areas, with well-organized hydration and feeding points. The event also includes live streaming, modern facilities, and prizes for winners.
course_highlights: The Ultra 50k route passes through forests, urban areas, and ski slopes around Cluj
Hydration and feeding points with water, isotonic drinks, fruits, and sweets
The last 12 km are mostly downhill, with a single ascent of over 100 meters
additional: The runner's kit includes a race number with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and real-time rankings, finisher medal, access to hydration and feeding points with sweet and salty products, still and mineral water, isotonic drinks, supplements, and fruits. There is a refund guarantee if announced by November 9, 2026. Time limits are 9 hours for Ultra 50k, 5 hours for Half 25k, 3 hours for Cross 15k, and 1 hour 30 minutes for Mini EcoTrail 7k. The event also features children's races Play&Run and an awards ceremony at 15:00. Multiple race distances including Ultra 50k, Half 25k, Cross 15k, Mini EcoTrail 7k, and children's races; events take place from November 28 to December 1, 2026, with exhibitions, kit distribution, and award ceremonies.

name: MARATON 1 DECEMBRIE
description: The December 1st Marathon is an annual competition held in IOR Park in Bucharest, dedicated to runners of all levels. The event offers a pleasant sporting experience, with well-organized routes and a friendly atmosphere. Participants can benefit from participation kits and careful organizational support, ensuring a safe and motivating race. The marathon also supports charitable causes, involving the community in a noble purpose.
course_highlights: Route held in IOR Park, Bucharest
Participation kits handed out in person or through a representative with documents
Kit pickup schedule over three days before the race
additional: Kit pickup takes place over three days before the race at locations in Bucharest: SportGuru Store (B-dul Unirii, no. 69) and ParkLake Shopping Center. The kit is only handed to the registered and validated person, based on an identity document, and can be collected by another person only with a signed copy of the ID. For the youth race, the kit is only handed to minors accompanied by a parent or legal guardian who signs a declaration of physical and medical fitness. Participation includes races for different categories and supports charitable causes; the event has a tradition of promoting an active and healthy lifestyle.

description: Cluj EcoTrail Ultramarathon is an emblematic event celebrating Romania on National Day, offering runners a unique trail running experience in the picturesque landscapes around Cluj. In its 9th edition, the main race Ultra 50k is favored by trail runners for its challenge and the beauty of the route, which includes forests, ascents, and spectacular descents. Participants can support one of Romania's 9 historical regions, and the atmosphere is friendly and festive, with well-equipped refreshment points and personalized medals for finishers. The event also includes races for all ages and levels, from Mini EcoTrail to team races.
course_highlights: 50 km route with ascents and descents through the forests around Cluj
Control and hydration points with varied food (water, isotonic drinks, fruits, sweets, salty foods)
Scenic views over Cluj Napoca and iconic areas such as Borhanci, Muzeul Poarta de’ Feleac, and Feleacu ski slopes
additional: The runner's kit includes a race number with a timing chip, access to the LiveTrail app for GPS tracking and real-time rankings, a personalized finisher medal, access to hydration and refreshment points with sweet, salty, isotonic drinks, and fruits. There are races for children and team races with special distancing rules between members. Time limits: 9 hours for Ultra 50k, 5 hours for Half 25k, 3 hours for Cross 15k, 1 hour 30 minutes for Mini EcoTrail 7k. Refund insurance is included if announced by November 9. Participants can support various Romanian historical regions and enjoy diverse routes, from trail to cross, with open registrations and early bird prices.

name: OVB Charity RUN
description: OVB Charity Run is a charity race organized in Cluj-Napoca, dedicated to runners of all levels who wish to support a noble cause through sport. The event offers a pleasant running experience in a friendly environment, promoting the local running community and social involvement. This is the first edition of this race, inviting participants to enjoy running and contribute to the common good.
course_highlights: 6 km route in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca
Supports the 'Saint Nectarie' Palliative Care Center for severely ill children
Options of 2 km race (family, non-competitive) and 6 km race (competitive)
additional: Participants can register until December 5, 2025; the event takes place in Central Park, Cluj-Napoca, and supports the pediatric cause through donations and sponsorships.

name: XL kmrun - Северен парк
description: XL kmrun - North Park is a race from the 5kmrun calendar held in North Park, Sofia. Participants can choose between three distances - 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km, suitable for different levels of preparation. The event offers an opportunity to run in a natural environment with varied terrain and is part of the XLkmrun series of races held at various locations around Sofia. This is a traditional winter race that attracts runners from the city and the region.
course_highlights: Three distances: 6 km, 12 km, and 18 km
Terrain with alternating ascents and descents
Held in North Park, Sofia
additional: The distances allow for selection according to capabilities and desired intensity. The race is part of the winter calendar of XLkmrun and takes place in conditions suitable for winter running. The event includes different distances and is part of a series of events promoting an active lifestyle in Sofia.

name: Everesting+ Ultra Zărand
description: Ultra Zarand Everesting+ is an extreme mountain running race held in Căsoaia, Arad County, Romania, on December 11-12, 2026. The event offers two challenging distances: 172 km with a positive elevation gain of 9,250 meters, considered difficult, and 86 km with 4,600 meters of elevation difference, of intermediate difficulty. The race is recognized for its demanding mountain terrain and the Everesting challenge, making it suitable for experienced runners seeking top endurance competition. Participants can track their performances through a personalized results board.
course_highlights: Distances of 86 km and 172 km with positive elevation gains of 4,600 m and 9,250 m respectively
Mountain terrain with intermediate and difficult difficulty levels
Everesting event with extreme endurance challenges
additional: The event features a personalized results board for participants to track their performance. There are no details about registration fees or start times. The race has a UTMB index for both distances, indicating international recognition of its difficulty. The event also includes a 10 km race to promote local tourism and natural and cultural heritage, offering a unique opportunity for ultramarathon and mountain running enthusiasts.

name: Semimaraton „Pe Argeș în Jos”
description: The 'Down Argeș Half Marathon' is an annual sporting event held in the heart of Pitești, bringing together runners of all levels. The routes start from Strand Park, pass through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks, and continue along the Argeș River promenade, offering a unique natural and urban setting for running. The event includes races for all ages and fitness levels, from children's races to the 21 km half marathon, promoting a healthy lifestyle and the local community. The atmosphere is lively, with supporters, music, and prizes for participants.
course_highlights: Start and finish at Strand Park, near the Summer Theater
Route through Lunca Argeșului and Strand parks
Running along the Argeș River promenade, with scenic views
additional: Kit pickup is on December 12 at EF Store and on December 14 at the Summer Theater for those outside Pitești. The start of the half marathon, 5 km, and 10 km races is at 10:00 AM in Strand Park. The children's race begins at 12:30 PM, and the awards ceremony is at 1:00 PM. Participants under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian at registration and kit pickup. The event includes online registration, kit pickup on 12.12.2026, and results and photo verification after the event.

name: Велинград Ултра
price_range: 23 евро за тениска, други цени не са посочени
description: Velingrad Ultra is the inaugural edition of an ultramarathon race offering three challenging courses in the Spa capital of the Balkans - Velingrad. Participants can choose between 11 km, 27 km, and 43 km mountain routes with varying elevation, passing through picturesque natural landscapes. The event includes professional organization, trail marking, support stations, and medals for all finishers. It is an opportunity to immerse yourself in the magic of the mountains and enjoy sport and nature combined.
course_highlights: Courses with lengths of 11 km (520 m elevation gain), 27 km (1420 m elevation gain), and 43 km (2100 m elevation gain)
Mountain terrain with marked trails and support stations
Start and finish in the center of Velingrad - the Spa capital of the Balkans
additional: Start packages include a medal, a souvenir with the event logo, timing, and a race bib. Registration and collection of start packages are from 07:00 to 11:00 on race day. Cut-off times are set for the 27 km and 43 km distances. There is an option to purchase a T-shirt for 23 euros. Additional mandatory gear is not included in the start package. The routes include different lengths, registration is on April 4, 2026, the race includes medals, photos, and support stations; additional gear is required.

name: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA ~ 2026
location: Satul Roșu, Chiajna, Ilfov County, Romania
description: TTR BACKYARD ULTRA 2026 is an official endurance running competition organized by the TIME TRIAL RUNNING community, supported by the Chiajna City Hall and local parishes. The event takes place in the village of Roșu, Chiajna commune, on April 17, 2026, starting at 14:00, at the Sports Hall of the "Doamna Chiajna" Technological High School. It is a unique Backyard Ultra race, with a single event covering a distance of 6.706 km, alternating between two different routes, one during the day and one at night. The challenge is to complete the route in less than 60 minutes and to be present at each hourly start, with the last remaining competitor declared the winner.
course_highlights: Unique distance of 6.706 km with two different routes alternated
Day route along the dyke/west side of Lake Morii
Night route through the streets of Roșu village and Chiajna promenade
additional: The start is given exactly on the hour, every hour, and participants must complete the route in less than 60 minutes to continue. The base camp includes indoor spaces (Sports Hall with changing rooms and toilets) and outdoor spaces (synthetic grass park). A refreshment and hydration point is available at the start/finish area, and hot meals will be offered according to the schedule. The winner (Last One Standing), second place (Assist), and the best-placed girl (Last Woman Standing) will be awarded. Each participant receives a personalized trophy at the end. The event includes routes along the shores of Lake Morii and the Chiajna promenade, with participation limited to 100 competitors, and offers hot meals and personalized trophies.

name: Cheile Turzii Race
location: Rezervația Naturală Cheile Turzii, Cluj County, Romania
description: Cheile Turzii Race is a mountain running competition organized in the heart of Transylvania, in the Cheile Turzii Natural Reserve, Romania. The event offers two races: a 9 km cross with 680 m elevation gain and a 23 km semi-marathon with 1300 m elevation gain, on technical and spectacular routes with dramatic landscapes and mountain trails. Participants can experience running under limestone cliffs, crossing bridges over the Hășdate River, and ascending to impressive panoramic points. It is a race suitable for both beginners and experienced runners seeking authentic mountain challenges.
course_highlights: Technical routes on mountain trails and forest roads
Spectacular landscapes with limestone cliffs and dramatic gorges
Climb towards the Săndulești Cross with 360° views over the Apuseni Mountains
additional: Start and finish are in front of the Cheile Turzii Salvamont Base. The participation kit includes a personalized textile bag and a finisher medal; technical T-shirt or sweatshirt is purchased separately. There are refreshment and hydration points along the route with water, Cola, isotonic drinks, fruits, and snacks. Kit pickup is on Friday, April 17, between 16:00-20:00 at Iulius Mall Cluj-Napoca and at Cheile Turzii between 19:00-21:00, with the possibility of pickup on the morning of the race. Awards ceremony takes place at 15:30 at the Mihai Viteazu Town Hall Cabin. Mountain routes, two races, tourism promotion, maximum 400 participants.

name: Medieval Trail Race
description: Medieval Trail Race is a mountain running competition held in Arad County, Romania, on tourist trails in the Zărand Mountains, between the localities of Șoimoș and Șiria. The event promotes both mountain running and the natural and historical heritage of the area, connecting the castles of Șoimoș and Șiria by running, as well as other points of interest. The routes offer an adventure experience with spring landscapes and a medieval atmosphere, suitable for both amateurs and professionals. The 2026 edition is the 5th and is part of the ITRA National League and UTMB Index calendar.
course_highlights: Mountain routes with tourist trails, forest roads, and paved roads
Historical sites: Șoimoș Fortress, Șiria Fortress, Feredeu Monastery, Feredeu Hermitage
Significant elevation differences: 445 m (9 km), 1026 m (22 km), 2075 m (44 km)
additional: The participant kit is guaranteed for registrations until April 12, 2026. The routes are marked with bands and arrows, and participants must pass through all control points. Medical assistance and monitoring are available on the route. On-site registrations are only possible for the 9 km cross and 22 km half marathon, without kit guarantee. Cancelling registration before February 28, 2026, refunds 50% of the participation fee. The routes include tourist trails from the Zărand Mountains, with details about registrations and participation conditions; the event takes place on April 18, 2026.

name: Maratonul Argonauților
location: Dobrogea Gorges, Gura Dobrogei, Constanța County, Romania
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, a picturesque area in Romania, with a marathon route that includes a positive elevation gain of 1600 meters. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and offers participants a unique experience in nature, on routes that promote the beauty of the natural reserves of Dobrogea. In addition to the marathon, other races are organized such as the half marathon, cross country, family race, and the canyon circuit, targeting a wide audience of runners. The marathon has a tradition and a story inspired by the Argonauts, heroes from Greek mythology, which adds a special charm to the competition.
course_highlights: Marathon route with a positive elevation gain of 1600 meters
Course through Cheile and Gura Dobrogei, protected natural reserves
Picturesque landscapes and promotion of local tourist routes
additional: The event includes several races: Marathon, Ioan Chifu Half Marathon, Cross Country, Family Race, and Canyon Circuit. The organizer is the Activ Pontica Sports Association. The routes are promoted as part of the natural and tourist heritage of the Dobrogea region. The event promotes local tourism and the natural beauty of Dobrogea, with varied routes and multiple race categories.

name: Maratonul Argonautilor
description: The Argonauts Marathon is a running competition held in the Dobrogea Gorges, Dobrogea, offering a unique experience on routes with a positive elevation change of 1600 meters. The event is organized by the Activ Pontica Sports Association and promotes the natural beauty of the Gorges and Gura Dobrogei area, inviting runners to discover spectacular landscapes and natural reserves. The course is suitable for both experienced runners and those who wish to enjoy nature and outdoor sports. The marathon has a tradition that evokes the legend of the Argonauts, the heroes who set out in search of the Golden Fleece, adding a mythological touch to the competition.
course_highlights: Route with a positive elevation change of 1600 meters
Course through the Gorges and Gura Dobrogei, areas with natural reserves
Spectacular landscapes and promotion of the local tourist trail
additional: The course includes areas of gorges and natural reserves, registrations and regulations are available on the website, the event takes place on April 19, 2026

name: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge
price_range: 250 lei pentru înscriere de ultim moment fără kit
description: Dălhăuți Trail Challenge is a mountain running competition taking place on April 19, 2026, in the village of Dălhăuți, Vrancea County. The event is organized by the Velopower Sports Association and promotes running on varied terrain, including forest trails and forest roads. Participants can enjoy a well-marked route with control points and a friendly atmosphere, complemented by an awards ceremony and a traditional lunch at the end. The start is scheduled at 10:00 AM, after a technical briefing and a coffee warm-up. The event emphasizes socializing and promoting outdoor activity.
course_highlights: Varied terrain route: forest trails and forest roads
Visibly marked route with tape, arrows, and signs
Control points with time limits for each stage
additional: Validation and kit pickup between 08:00 and 09:30. Last-minute registrations available for only 20 spots, without a start kit, with a fee of 250 RON. Mandatory equipment for stages: mobile phone, visible race number, liquid container (minimum 0.5 liters) for the 21 km stage, survival blanket. The champions' lunch with beans and sausages after runners arrive. Awards ceremony at 14:30. The event concludes at 16:00 with group photos and socializing. The route includes trail terrain, details about registration, event schedule, and post-race activities.

description: Brăila 10K is a running race organized in Monument Park in Brăila, on April 19, 2026, offering an energizing and friendly experience for runners of all ages. The event includes races of 10.5 km, 7 km, 3.5 km, children's races, and a 1.5 km Family Fun Run, making it ideal for setting a personal record on a fast and well-marked course. The festival atmosphere, music, prizes, and activities for the whole family make Brăila 10K a celebration of movement and outdoor health. Organizers emphasize safety and smooth conduct of the competition, with volunteers and referees present on the course.
course_highlights: Fast course of 10.5 km, 7 km, and 3.5 km through Monument Park
Well-marked routes supervised by referees and volunteers
1.5 km Family Fun Run for the whole family
additional: Kit pickup is on Saturday, April 18, 2026, at Braila Mall between 10:30 and 19:00, and on Sunday, April 19, 2026, at the tent in the start/finish area. There is baggage check for the competitive races and the Family Fun Run. The Family Fun Run is non-competitive and accessible to everyone. Start times for children's races are separated by age categories. No registrations are accepted on race day for the competitive events. The event includes warm-up sessions with specialized instructors before the starts. Participants can receive medals, prizes, and surprises, and the event features activities for the entire family. Details about the course and registration are available on the official website.
